title: Business Innovation Manager (m/w/d) – AI, MarTech & Digital Solutions
descriptionHtml:
100% remote.

Neue AI-Tools, autonome Agenten, Automatisierungen, neue Plattformen oder smartere Wege, digitales Marketing effizienter zu machen: Wenn Technologie auf Marketing trifft, wirst Du neugierig.

Und noch besser: Du willst nicht nur darüber reden, sondern ausprobieren, bauen und umsetzen.

Wir sind eine unabhängige Digital-Performance-Agentur aus Deutschland und verbinden über 25 Jahre Marketing-Erfahrung mit AI, First-Party Data, eigener Technologie und datengetriebenen Lösungen.

Als Business Innovation Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest Du direkt mit unserem Director of Business Innovation und unserem Innovation-Team zusammen. Ihr identifiziert neue Möglichkeiten, testet Ideen und entwickelt daraus Lösungen, die bei uns und unseren Kunden tatsächlich etwas bewegen.

Kurz gesagt: Du machst aus „Das müsste man mal ausprobieren“ ein „Läuft.“

Dein Spielfeld:

  • Du findest heraus, was wirklich Potenzial hat.
    Neue AI-Anwendungen, APIs, Plattformen, Automatisierungen oder Entwicklungen im digitalen Marketing: Du behältst den Überblick, probierst Neues aus und bewertest, was für hurra.com und unsere Kunden echten Mehrwert bringt – und was einfach nur der nächste Hype ist.

  • Du baust Lösungen statt PowerPoints.
    Aus guten Ideen machst Du funktionierende Lösungen. Du entwickelst Prototypen, Tools, Automatisierungen und Workflows und bringst sie von der ersten Idee bis in den produktiven Einsatz. Dabei kann es um AI, Data, Search, Media, Content, Analytics oder ganz neue Marketing-Technologien gehen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen auch gut bleiben.
    Was funktioniert, wird nicht einfach abgehakt. Du entwickelst bestehende Tools und Anwendungen weiter, machst sie stabiler und skalierbarer und kümmerst Dich darum, dass sie im Alltag zuverlässig laufen.

  • Du bringst Marketing, Business und Tech zusammen.
    Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Search, Media, Data, Strategy und weiteren Bereichen zusammen. Du verstehst ihre Herausforderungen, übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen und bist Sparringspartner für neue Ideen und deren Machbarkeit.

Das solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Du kennst digitales Marketing und denkst technisch.
    Du musst nicht in jeder Disziplin Spezialist sein. Aber Du solltest verstehen, wie digitales Marketing funktioniert und Spaß daran haben, es mit Technologie besser zu machen.

  • Du baust Dinge, statt nur darüber zu reden.
    Du probierst aus, entwickelst Prototypen, verbindest Systeme und schreibst auch mal ein Script. APIs, Automatisierungen, AI-Schnittstellen, LLMs und AI-Agenten sind für Dich keine Buzzwords, sondern Werkzeuge, mit denen Du echte Lösungen baust.

  • Du wartest nicht auf das nächste Briefing.
    Du erkennst neue Möglichkeiten, entwickelst eigene Ideen und bringst Themen selbstständig voran. Wenn etwas noch keine fertige Lösung hat, wird es für Dich erst interessant.

  • Du kannst technische Themen verständlich machen.
    Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe – auch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die nicht jeden Tag mit APIs oder AI-Agenten arbeiten. Dafür solltest Du Deutsch verhandlungssicher beherrschen. Gute Englischkenntnisse helfen Dir zusätzlich.

Was Dich bei uns erwartet:

  • 100 % remote und flexibel.
    Arbeite dort, wo Du am besten arbeitest – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und ohne unnötige Präsenzpflicht.

  • Verantwortung statt Micromanagement.
    Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Dinge auszuprobieren und Themen gemeinsam mit dem Director of Business Innovation voranzutreiben.

  • Eine ziemlich große Spielwiese.
    AI, Data, Automatisierung, MarTech, Search, Media, neue Plattformen und eigene Technologien: Dein Themenfeld ist bewusst breit.

  • Direkter Weg von der Idee zur Umsetzung.
    Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammen. Gute Ideen sollen bei uns nicht in Präsentationen verschwinden, sondern ausprobiert werden.

  • Benefits, die zählen.
    EGYM Wellpass, Bike-Leasing, moderne technische Ausstattung und ein Team mit ziemlich viel Know-how in Search, Data, Media und Tech.

So einfach bewirbst Du Dich:

Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Schick uns Deinen CV und ein kurzes Video – zum Beispiel über Loom. In zwei bis drei Minuten würden wir gerne von Dir erfahren:

  • Welche Technologie oder welches digitale Marketing-Thema Dich gerade wirklich begeistert

  • Was Du zuletzt gebaut, automatisiert, getestet oder verbessert hast

  • Wie Du an technische Herausforderungen herangehst, für die es noch keine fertige Lösung gibt

  • Was wir unbedingt über Dich wissen sollten

Das Video ist fester Bestandteil Deiner Bewerbung - ohne geht's nicht. Uns interessiert nicht nur, was in Deinem CV steht, sondern auch, wie Du denkst, Probleme angehst und über Technologie sprichst.

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

title: Business Systems Analyst
descriptionHtml:
London or Sheffield - 2 days per week in office, 3 days working remotely

ABOUT THE ROLE

Goodlord’s mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re on the hunt for a Business Systems Analyst to help us achieve this.

The Business Systems team plays a crucial role in driving efficiency across multiple departments including Sales, Customer Support, Marketing and Finance by optimising our internal processes and connected ecosystem. As a hands-on analyst, you will work throughout the full SDLC: partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their challenges, scoping scalable solutions, and implementing them directly in Salesforce.

Your work will be critical to driving business growth and achieving our strategic goals. To accomplish this, you will employ advanced automation and Salesforce’s latest AI capabilities to solve real business problems rather than just completing tasks. You will ensure robust data governance, seamless integrations with platforms like HubSpot, and disciplined process execution.

No two days are ever the same at Goodlord so what you’ll be up to will vary. The pace we move at also means priorities will change and you’ll need to be comfortable with this (we’ll support you!). But these are the things that will be core to your role and will keep you busy.

The day-to-day stuff:

  • Flexibly balance a mix of business as usual system admin tasks alongside the execution of long-term, strategic projects.

  • Partner directly with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their operational challenges, gather requirements, and translate them into clear, documented technical specifications.

  • Own the administration, configuration, and day-to-day support of core enablement tools and integrations, including GetAccept, Vonage, and HubSpot.

  • Map, manage and continuously improve the operational processes underlying our sales cycles.

  • Utilise Salesforce reporting, Data Loader, Import Wizard, etc to maintain an accurate database, while building visibility (dashboards/reports) for everyone from end-users to the executive team.

  • Proactively spot, triage, and systematically debug new system, AI, or process issues as they arise, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

ABOUT YOU

You should apply if you:

  • Hands-on experience in Salesforce configuration and advanced declarative automation. Understanding of best-practice configuration to prevent over-customization.

  • Working familiarity of modern Salesforce AI capabilities with a keen eye for identifying where AI can solve real-world business challenges, automate manual tasks, and drive operational efficiency.

  • Experience partnering with business stakeholders to map business processes, challenge assumptions, and translate pain points into scalable solutions rather than just "taking orders."

  • Literacy in integration logic, data sync behaviors, and APIs (e.g., interfacing Salesforce with HubSpot and plugins like GetAccept).

  • A systematic approach to debugging, documentation, and testing along with strict adherence to internal change management processes.

 

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

title: Care Strategy Lead

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Care team at GetYourGuide exists to make every interaction with our platform - for travellers, suppliers, and partners - feel effortless, trusted, and human. We sit at the intersection of customer experience, operational excellence, and business strategy, and we play a critical role in ensuring that the people who power our marketplace can thrive on it. From how we design our support channels to how we measure and improve satisfaction, Care is a strategic function that directly shapes GetYourGuide's reputation and growth.

Within Care, the Care Experience & Strategy team drives the thinking and direction behind how we support our stakeholders at scale. We translate company strategy into Care roadmaps, lead cross-functional initiatives that improve the experience of travellers, suppliers, and partners, and ensure that data and insight - not assumption - guide every decision we make. As Senior Strategy Lead for Partner Support & Success, you will be a senior individual contributor, owning the strategic agenda for how Care serves and grows our supplier and partner relationships, with direct impact on stakeholder satisfaction and GMV.

Your mission

  • Define and own a stakeholder segment of the Care strategy, starting with partner and supplier support and success - setting the direction for how we engage, support, and grow these relationships, and translating company OKRs into a clear, prioritised Care roadmap

title: CDI - AI Engineer Manager - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.

Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.
  • Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.
  • Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.
  • Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.
  • Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.
  • Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.
  • Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.
  2. Votre code est testé et maintenable.
  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.
  4. La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.
  5. Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.
  6. Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.
  • Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.
  • Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.
  • Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.
  • Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CDI - HR Data & Social Controlling Analyst H/F
descriptionHtml:
Mission principale

Rattachée à la Head of HR Operations, le/la HR Data & Social Controlling Analyst assure le pilotage de la masse salariale et des effectifs, tout en développant une approche analytique et data-driven de la fonction RH.

Il/elle garantit la fiabilité des données sociales, contribue à la construction et au suivi du budget RH, automatise les reportings et transforme les données RH en analyses pertinentes en étroite collaboration avec la Direction Financière.

Principales responsabilités

A. Contrôle de gestion sociale et pilotage de la masse salariale

  • Construire le budget annuel de masse salariale et des effectifs, en lien avec la DRH, la Direction Financière et les équipes opérationnelles.

  • Élaborer les prévisions actualisées (forecasts) et les projections de fin d'année.

  • Analyser les écarts entre réalisé, budget et prévisions, et identifier les principaux facteurs explicatifs.

  • Modéliser les effets des évolutions d'effectifs, des augmentations salariales, des promotions, des bonus, des départs et des recrutements.

  • Réaliser des simulations financières pour accompagner les décisions RH : recrutements, réorganisations, politiques de rémunération et évolution des effectifs.

  • Suivre les principaux indicateurs économiques et sociaux : masse salariale, effectifs, rémunération moyenne, coûts des recrutements et autres coûts RH.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus de contrôle et de fiabilisation des données de paie et de rémunération.

  • Préparer les analyses nécessaires aux revues budgétaires et aux présentations destinées au CODIR.

B. HR Data Analytics et aide à la décision

  • Exploiter et croiser les données issues du SIRH, de la paie, du recrutement et des autres outils RH.

  • Analyser les tendances RH et identifier les principaux facteurs d'évolution des indicateurs sociaux.

  • Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur le turnover, l'absentéisme, le recrutement, la mobilité interne, les rémunérations et les parcours professionnels.

  • Identifier les populations, métiers ou entités nécessitant une attention particulière et formuler des recommandations opérationnelles.

  • Développer des analyses permettant d'évaluer l'efficacité des politiques RH et d'en mesurer les résultats.

  • Concevoir des analyses prospectives et, lorsque les données le permettent, des modèles de prévision pour anticiper les évolutions des effectifs et des indicateurs sociaux.

  • Traduire les résultats des analyses en recommandations compréhensibles et directement exploitables par les équipes RH et les managers.

C. Reporting, Business Intelligence et automatisation

  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer les tableaux de bord RH et les reportings destinés à la DRH, au CODIR et aux équipes opérationnelles.

  • Automatiser la production des reportings récurrents afin de réduire les tâches manuelles et de sécuriser les résultats.

  • Développer des dashboards interactifs permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés et d'analyser les données par métier, entité, pays, population ou niveau hiérarchique.

  • Harmoniser les définitions, les règles de calcul et les référentiels des indicateurs RH.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité, de la cohérence et de la disponibilité des données sociales.

  • Participer à l'évolution des outils de reporting et à l'optimisation des processus de collecte et d'exploitation des données.

D. Projets RH

  • Participer activement à l’ensemble des exercices annuels liés aux sujets Comp & Ben :

  • Révision annuelle des salaires, évaluation des bonus, plan de commissionnement pour les équipes de vente.

  • Etudes de rémunérations, benchmarks internes et externes.

Profil recherché

Formation

  • Bac +5 en contrôle de gestion, finance, statistiques, data analytics, ressources humaines ou école de commerce avec spécialisation pertinente.

  • Une double compétence en finance et en data constitue un atout.

Expérience

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion sociale, HR Analytics, contrôle de gestion ou analyse de données, idéalement avec une exposition aux problématiques RH.

  • Une expérience dans le retail, la mode, le luxe ou un environnement multi-entités est appréciée.

Compétences techniques

  • Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et des fonctions avancées d'analyse de données.

  • Bonne maîtrise de Power BI.

  • Capacité à manipuler, consolider et analyser des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes.

  • Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de masse salariale, des rémunérations, des effectifs et des principaux indicateurs sociaux.

  • Capacité à construire des modèles budgétaires, des prévisions et des analyses de sensibilité.

  • La connaissance du système de paie ADP est un avantage.

  • Doté d’un esprit analytique, vous êtes rigoureux et proactif, vous comprenez l’environnement Business, et êtes à l’aise dans la collaboration avec les différents départements.

Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.

title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.

  • Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.

  • Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.

  • Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.

  • Une certification cloud.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

descriptionHtml:
What is Finary?

Money is broken. Most people's wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see, and a private banker costs more than they will ever pay. We are putting one in everyone's pocket: the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us, for free. Finary AI turns that financial context into a plan, and our own investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real: clarity on what you have, guidance on where you are going, action to get there.

Why now?

AI makes this vision possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy:

  • Data: years of per-user financial history, goals and risk profiles that no public dataset holds.

  • Brand: half of our new users come from our own channels, and 1 signup in 5 names our YouTube channel.

  • Licences: stocks, ETFs and crypto on one regulated platform, passportable across Europe. We started early, when a simple registration was enough: PSAN in 2022, Investment Firm licence in March 2026, MiCA in July 2026. Since July, every crypto platform in Europe must be licensed or stop.

Many fintechs will have the AI, and a few will have the licences. We have all 3. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman) and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise). There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Read more about our values here.

The role

The CEO Office owns Finary's most important strategic projects, the delivery of the business plan, company’s operating rituals and runs the board and investor relations. Today one Chief of Staff carries all of it. You join as a real partner: you own a share of these projects from day one and move key topics forward fast, side by side with the Chief of Staff and the CEO.

What success looks like

  • After 1 month: you know Finary's business, numbers and new vision, and you run the operating rituals.

Who you are

title: Co-Founder & COO (m/w/d) gesucht für Corporate Philanthropy Plattform | Düsseldorf/Remote
descriptionHtml:
Über Bonoboo


Bei Bonoboo bauen wir die Plattform für Corporate Philanthropy. Mit KI-gestütztem Matchmaking verbinden wir Unternehmen gezielt mit passenden gemeinnützigen Organisationen. Das Ziel: messbare Wirkung, effizientere Spendenprozesse und datenbasiertes gesellschaftliches Engagement. Wir sind ein wachsendes, internationales Team mit Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf und wollen die Spendenbranche nachhaltig verändern.

Wo wir stehen
Unser Produkt ist validiert, und erste Unternehmen setzen Bonoboo bereits zahlend ein. Wir sind mitten in der Pre-Seed-Phase, mehrere Business Angels sind an Bord, und das Kapital für die nächsten Schritte ist gesichert. Jetzt geht es darum, aus einem funktionierenden Produkt ein skalierendes Unternehmen zu machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Wer wir sind

  • Julia, CEO & Founder: bringt Expertise in Sales und Finance mit und verantwortet Vertrieb, Finanzen und Fundraising.

  • Max, CTO & Co-Founder: hat Erfahrung als KI-Entwickler und verantwortet Produkt und Tech.

Was uns noch fehlt, ist die Person, die den Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo nicht nur mitdenkt, sondern operativ führt und nach außen trägt.

Deine Aufgaben als Co-Founder & COO

Du verantwortest den gesamten Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres Start-ups maßgeblich mit.

Strategie & Impact
Du denkst mit uns die großen Fragen: Wie skaliert Corporate Philanthropy? Wo hebeln wir Wirkung am stärksten? Du bringst strategische Klarheit in ein Feld, das oft unscharf bleibt.

Operative Leitung Impact
Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für alles, was mit Impact zu tun hat, von Prozessen bis zur Reporting-Logik. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Vision gelebte Praxis wird.

NGO-Partnernetzwerk & Success Management
Du baust unser Netzwerk an NGO-Partner:innen auf und pflegst es. Du verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und sorgst dafür, dass Partnerschaften auf der Plattform für beide Seiten wirklich funktionieren.

Bühne & Pitches
Du bist eines der Gesichter von Bonoboo: auf Startup-Bühnen, bei Pitches und im Gespräch mit Kund:innen, Partner:innen und Investor:innen. Du erzählst unsere Story mit Substanz, Überzeugung und Begeisterung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in Strategy, Business Development oder Operations, idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu CSR, HR oder dem NGO-Sektor

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du treibst Dinge eigenständig voran und baust Prozesse und Strukturen auf, statt nur darüber zu reden.

  • Kommunikationstalent: Du begeisterst andere für Impact-Themen, auf der Bühne genauso überzeugend wie im 1:1 mit unseren NGO-Partner:innen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung für das Ganze übernehmen und Bonoboo gemeinsam mit uns aufbauen und skalieren.

  • Leidenschaft für Impact: Du glaubst daran, dass Unternehmen und NGOs gemeinsam mehr bewegen können, wenn die Partnerschaft wirklich passt.

Deine ersten Monate

In den ersten drei bis sechs Monaten baust du unser NGO-Partnernetzwerk systematisch aus. Du setzt die Prozesse für Matching und Impact Reporting auf und stehst bei den ersten Pitches mit auf der Bühne. Gemeinsam mit Julia und Max legst du fest, wie Bonoboo im nächsten Jahr wachsen soll.

Das bieten wir

  1. Teil des Gründungsteams: Anteile, Mitsprache und Einfluss auf die Richtung des Unternehmens. Bonoboo wird auch dein Unternehmen.

  2. Flexibles Arbeiten: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitstag selbst und arbeitest dort, wo du am produktivsten bist. Für die wichtigen Momente treffen wir uns regelmäßig in Düsseldorf.

  3. Raum zum Wachsen: Austausch mit unseren Business Angels und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk für deine persönliche und unternehmerische Entwicklung.

  4. Ein modernes Software-Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Impact

  5. Ein Team, das schnell entscheidet und mit Leidenschaft arbeitet

  6. Die Chance, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten und Corporate Philanthropy neu zu denken

Vergütung

3.000–6.000 € brutto im Monat, plus Unternehmensanteile. Die konkrete Beteiligung legen wir gemeinsam im Kennenlernprozess fest.

So lernen wir uns kennen

  1. Erstes Gespräch: lockeres Kennenlernen. Wer bist du, wer sind wir, passt das grundsätzlich?

  2. Zweites Gespräch: Wir steigen tiefer ein, in Impact, Strategie und deine fachliche Perspektive auf Bonoboo.

  3. Drittes Treffen, gerne persönlich in Düsseldorf: Wir lernen uns auf persönlicher Ebene kennen und sprechen über Anteile und die Rahmenbedingungen.

Klingt nach dir? Dann melde dich bei uns. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

descriptionHtml:
Description des tâches à faire

GCBOAL02 Business Management & Développement

Bac+5 0-1 an Télétravail

Nous vous offrons

  • Expertise en économie circulaire et audit de terrain (ACV, empreinte chromatique) appliquée à la restauration et à la santé publique (normes PNNS).

Votre profil pour avancer ensemble

  • Formation : niveau Master, issu de cursus spécialisés dans les domaines de la nutrition/santé publique, de l'environnement/développement durable, ou du management de la restaura tion/agroalimentaire.

Maîtrise des concepts de santé liés à la nutrition (PNNS, qualité nutritionnelle). Capacité à analyser des données issues de grilles d'évaluation ou d'audits (Empreinte chromatique).

  • Esprit créatif, excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse

  • Esprit d'équipe et transversalité : Collaborer efficacement avec d’autres pôles (par exemple, l'équipe statistique pour la modélisation des données ou l'équipe RH).

  • Bonne communication écrite et orale (français B2/C1 minimum)

Modalités du poste

Modalités du poste :

  • Début : immédiat ou à convenir

  • Format : télétravail

title: Compliance Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our Software as a Service (SaaS) platform connects owners, operators, service providers and residents. We work with housing associations, local authorities, student housing, later living and build-to-rent operators, across a growing network of 1.7M+ properties and 5,000+ service providers worldwide, reaching 3M+ engaged residents.

Our customers trust us with their residents’ data, their supply chains and their money. This role makes sure that trust is earned every day.

Mission

You'll run Plentific’s compliance programme day to day: KYC, data protection, ISO 27001, business risk and internal audit. You’ll make it practical, evidence-based and quick, using AI tools to do in hours what used to take days.

What you’ll own

  • KYC and due diligence

  • Data protection

  • ISO 27001 ISMS

  • Business risk register

  • Internal audit programme

  • Compliance policies and training

What you’ll do

KYC and due diligence

  • Run KYC checks on customers, suppliers and service providers: identity, ownership, sanctions, PEP and adverse media.

  • Set risk-based rules for when enhanced due diligence applies, and escalate cases that need a decision.

  • Keep KYC records complete and ready for audit or client review.

Data protection

  • Run day-to-day UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 compliance: records of processing, DPIAs, retention and data subject requests.

  • Review data processing agreements and supplier privacy terms with the legal team.

  • Manage personal data incidents from first report to close, including the decision on whether to notify the ICO within 72 hours.

Information security (ISO 27001)

  • Maintain the ISMS with Information Security Team: Statement of Applicability, risk treatment plan, control owners and evidence, etc.

  • Lead surveillance and recertification audits with our external certification body.

  • Answer security and compliance questionnaires from housing association and local authority clients.

Business risk and internal audit

  • Own the business risk register. Work with risk owners to rate, treat and report risks to the General Counsel and leadership team.

  • Plan and run an annual internal audit programme across information security, data protection and KYC, and track every finding to closure.

  • Report on compliance status and open risks in a format leadership can act on.

Policies, training and AI

  • Keep compliance policies current, short and written so people actually read them.

  • Run awareness training on data protection, information security and KYC.

  • Use AI tools every day to draft policies, review questionnaires and contracts, gather audit evidence and track regulatory change. Automate the repetitive checks.

  • Help shape how Plentific governs its own use of AI.

What you’ll need

  • 3+ years in a compliance, risk or information governance role, ideally in SaaS, fintech or another regulated tech business.

  • Good working knowledge of KYC checks, including sanctions, PEP and beneficial ownership screening, and the tools used to run them.

  • Hands-on experience of UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018: DPIAs, data subject requests, breach handling and supplier due diligence.

  • Experience running or supporting an ISO 27001 ISMS through certification and surveillance audits.

  • A track record of managing a business risk register and conducting internal audits. An ISO 27001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor qualification helps.

  • A CIPP/E or CIPM certification is beneficial.

  • AI training credentials are beneficial, such as the IAPP AIGP or an ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer course.

  • You use AI tools daily and can give real examples of how they made your work faster or better.

  • Clear writing, and the confidence to explain a compliance requirement to an engineer, a salesperson or a client.

Nice to have

  • Experience of AI governance, such as the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Not essential: if you don’t have it yet, you’ll learn it on the job.

Why Plentific

You'll join a scale up with ambitious growth plans and the backing to deliver them, in a role where you'll impact the future of housing:

title: Consultant to Senior Consultant, Capabilities, Customer Contact and Ai Experts
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Customer practice are looking for an experienced Consultant or Senior Consultant to join the team. 

Our Customer team is hiring a motivated and talented individual, from Consultants to Senior Consultants, to help our clients evolve how they serve their customers in a world increasingly shaped by AI. From rethinking the end-to-end customer journey through to embedding AI into day-to-day operations, we help clients turn ambition into something that actually works. 

What you will be doing

You’ll work side-by-side with clients to identify and drive improves in how customer service operates - understanding demand, journeys and pain points, and identifying where AI can genuinely add value to improve customer outcomes and efficiency. 

You’ll be designing and delivering real change - not just strategy on paper - getting into the detail of how contact centres run today, and what it takes to make improvement stick. 

You will be particularly focused on: 

  • Reimagining customer service:improving how contact centres operate - from demand management and journeys through to channel mix, automation and service design
  • Applying AI in customer environments: identifying and shaping where AI can add value across voice and digital channels (e.g. IVR, chat, agent assist), with a clear view on what will drive real operational impact
  • Hands-on end-to-end delivery: working across the lifecycle from strategy through to design and implementation - shaping roadmaps, standing up pilots and supporting real-world delivery
  • Owning delivery: leading workstreams or small pods - setting direction, driving progress and being accountable for outcomes
  • Working as one team with clients: leading workshops and aligning stakeholders across Product, Tech and Operations to move delivery forward at pace
  • Supporting growth:contributing to proposals and helping shape new opportunities across customer and AI
  • Supporting others: coaching junior team members and acting as a go-to within your area 

 
Your skills and experience 
 

We’re looking for people with strong foundations in customer and contact centre transformation, who bring a clear, practical perspective on how AI can be applied to improve service. 

  • Strong grounding in customer contact operations: deep understanding of how contact centres run day-to-day across voice and digital channels (sales, service, complaints), including demand drivers, KPIs and operational challenges 
  • Applied understanding of AI in service environments: able to identify, shape and prioritise AI use cases (e.g. IVR automation, chatbots, agent assist), with a clear view on feasibility, value and operational impact 
  • Experience with customer and AI technologies:understanding of the platforms that enable modern contact centres and AI capabilities, with a practical view of what works in the real world 
  • Structured thinking and clear point of view:able to frame problems, form recommendations and communicate clearly to senior stakeholders 
  • Strong client delivery: comfortable building high-quality outputs (strategies, roadmaps, business cases) and working at pace in delivery environments 
  • Data-driven decision making: using data and insight to identify opportunities, prioritise effectively and guide decisions 
  • Building value cases and buy-in: able to articulate clear value and bring stakeholders with you to support change 
  • Drive and ownership: comfortable navigating ambiguity, structuring problems and taking responsibility for outcomes 
  • Collaboration and stakeholder management:confident working across Product, Technology and Operations, bridging technical and non-technical teams 
  • Curiosity for how AI is evolving: keeps up to date with the space and brings practical insight into client work 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. title: Copy Editor English
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Copy Editor to join our team of English language experts for 14-18 months and help shape the language that medical professionals around the world rely on.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you.

You will:

  • Copyedit AMBOSS articles following our in-house style guide (based on the AMA Manual of Style), keeping content clear, correct, concise, and consistent

  • Edit Qbanks tailored to specific markets around the world

  • Work closely with our medical editors to discuss language issues, streamline content, and reach compromises when views differ

  • Collaborate with the multimedia, user experience, paid courses, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality output and consistency across the brand

  • Create, test, and refine AI tools and prompts that improve the language quality of our content

  • Critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted content to ensure linguistic accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to editorial standards

  • Support medical editors with language questions and explain our conventions and the reasoning behind them, both day-to-day and through workshops and other teaching formats

  • Help shape the language of our products and keep up to date with the latest developments in medical language

  • Maintain our in-house guides, flag when a new convention is needed, and refine editorial processes to work more efficiently

You bring:

  • Fluency in English (C2 level) and a deep interest in its intricacies

  • Substantial editing experience (scientific or medical editing is a plus) and a good grasp of medical terminology

  • Experience editing according to a style guide, with accuracy and attention to detail

  • Strong research skills, using reliable sources to check terminology and decide how best to convey information to users

  • Outstanding communication skills, a passion for explaining language conventions, and the ability to give and receive constructive feedback

  • Hands-on experience using LLMs, ideally in an editorial process, and awareness of their limitations (hallucinations, biases, outdated sources) and of legal and ethical considerations around data use and copyright

  • Structured work approach to manage multiple projects, adapt to changing weekly priorities, plan around dependencies, and keep teams informed

You enjoy:

  • Working with people from all over the world

  • Learning about every aspect of a company, from engineering to user research

  • Exploring evolving technologies and tools

  • Keeping up with the latest developments in medical language

  • Sharing ideas about language with a close-knit team

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

  • 🧠 Learning & Development (Internal & external trainings, workshops & hackathons, AI cross-talks & seminars, Blinkist access, and more…)

  • ☀️ Work From Somewhere Sunny (Access to our offices in Cagliari and Cape Town, visit the HQs, Berlin in summer)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-remote

We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

title: Credit Manager (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Chez EndLess, un service rendu est un service payé.

Nous collectons, trions et valorisons les déchets de chantier des professionnels du BTP en Île-de-France et dans le Sud : Big Bags, bennes, apport sur site, et une plateforme digitale propriétaire qui pilote nos flux en temps réel. Le groupe réalise 20 M€ de chiffre d’affaires, compte 25 personnes dans ses bureaux de Paris 15e, et grandit par croissance organique et par acquisitions.

Nous créons le poste de Credit Manager. Soyons francs : c’est un poste de terrain dans une PME, pas un poste de pilotage à distance. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui prend le téléphone, traite les litiges et mène ses dossiers de bout en bout.

Votre mission

Faire en sorte que chacune de nos prestations se transforme en cash, vite et proprement. Vous gérez l’ensemble du portefeuille clients en autonomie, sans équipe à encadrer, et vous êtes rattaché(e) à notre Responsable Administratif et Financier.

Le travail répétitif est déjà automatisé : chaque matin, un agent IA prépare votre liste d’appels priorisée, suit les promesses de paiement et surveille les procédures collectives. Vous gardez ce qui fait la différence : le téléphone, le jugement, la décision.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Appeler chaque jour vos clients, obtenir des engagements de paiement datés et chiffrés, et les faire tenir.
  • Traiter les litiges à la racine avec nos équipes Opérations, Planning et Expérience Client.
  • Animer le comité de crédit hebdomadaire : comptes à bloquer, à débloquer, conditions de paiement.
  • Mener les mises en demeure, les injonctions de payer et les déclarations de créance.
  • Suivre vos indicateurs : cash encaissé, délai de paiement, échu à plus de 90 jours.
  • Faire progresser le dispositif avec l’agent IA, et former nos commerciaux au réflexe « se faire payer ».

Votre profil

  • 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en recouvrement B2B ou en credit management, idéalement auprès de PME, dans le BTP ou les services.
  • Une vraie aisance au téléphone : ferme sur le fond, courtois sur la forme.

  • De la rigueur, de la ténacité, et l’habitude d’un logiciel comptable (Pennylane idéalement) et d’un tableur.

Ce que nous proposons

Notre process

Un premier échange avec un dirigeant, un entretien avec votre futur manager, un test technique puis un entretien « culture ».

title: CTO (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Chief Technology Officer, you will own TACTILIA's technology strategy, product architecture, and engineering execution. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization across project management, systems engineering, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product management, applications and testing. Your responsibility is to turn a highly capable robotic hand into a reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and scalable industrial product.

This is a leadership role with substantial technical depth. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every discipline, but you must have first-hand experience with both hardware and software development and the judgment to make sound system-level decisions across both.

What you will do:

Set the technology direction. Define TACTILIA’s technology strategy and product roadmap from the current platform to a scalable industrial product.

Lead the whole stack. Lead the teams across project management, systems, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product, applications and testing.

Make the architecture work. Own the system architecture and the interfaces between hardware, software, AI and applications.

Turn R&D into product. Drive the transition from advanced prototypes to reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and customer-ready products.

Make the right trade-offs. Balance performance, reliability, cost, safety, manufacturability and speed of execution.

Build the organization. Recruit, develop and lead the engineering and product organization across Zurich and Munich.

Create clarity and accountability. Establish effective priorities, processes, decision-making structures and technical standards across the teams.

Own resources and execution. Manage engineering budgets, headcount and priorities in line with the company’s product and business goals.

Stay close to customers. Translate customer requirements and field experience into product decisions and future technology direction.

Represent TACTILIA externally. Act as the technical face of the company with customers, partners, SCHUNK, investors and the robotics community.

Stay close to the hard problems. Remain sufficiently hands-on to challenge important technical decisions and unblock the team when necessary.

What you bring:

You can lead across hardware and software. You have deep practical understanding of both disciplines and the credibility to guide experts across mechanics, electronics, sensors, embedded systems, controls, AI and applications.

You have led complex engineering organizations. You have successfully led multidisciplinary teams, ideally with responsibility for 20 or more people, multiple functions and a significant budget.

You have shipped physical products. You have taken complex robotics, mechatronics, medical or industrial hardware from development or prototype stage into customer use, production or product maturity.

You understand human-like robotic systems. Ideally, you have experience in humanoid or biomedical robotics, particularly with anthropomorphic mechanisms, sensor and actuator systems, robotic hands or tendon-driven devices.

You think in systems. You can connect mechanics, electronics, sensing, control, software, AI and customer applications into a coherent product architecture.

You build teams that execute. You have a track record of recruiting strong people, developing leaders and creating a culture of ownership and high standards.

You know how to scale engineering. You bring experience from a startup, scale-up or industrial technology company and understand how to combine speed with disciplined execution.

You make sound decisions under uncertainty. You are pragmatic, commercially aware and able to distinguish between the perfect solution and the right solution.

You communicate with every audience. You can engage credibly with engineers, customers, executives, investors and industrial partners.

You have a strong technical foundation. A degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred.

You are ready to build internationally. You are fluent in English and comfortable working across the Zurich and Munich locations. German is an advantage.

Bonus:

  • Dexterous manipulation, grasp planning, or robotic hands

  • Tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote.

You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. Some of the accounts you'll inherit are in difficult places, so you'll be rebuilding trust, holding rooms independently and driving outcomes in ambiguity.

We're a high-performance team. Everyone holds an important seat and is expected to perform at an elite level. We have each other's backs, we assume good intent, and we have zero space for internal politics. If that's your default, you'll thrive here.

This is an on-site role. Four days a week you'll be in our London office or out with customers, with one day working from home. Regular travel to customers across the UK is part of the job.

Responsibilities

  • Own senior customer relationships at Director level and above (Operations, Finance, HR), in person as well as over video, and act as the escalation point for your accounts

  • Run the QBR cadence and own renewals end to end, so the value case is made long before the renewal conversation

  • Drive proactive value work: account audits, surfacing unused functionality, and translating product usage into business outcomes

  • Progress seat upsells as customers grow, and flag wider expansion opportunities to AEs

  • Hold difficult conversations with diplomacy, including product feedback that isn't on the roadmap

  • Manage customer-side projects such as integrations and configuration changes, keeping status visible so customers always know where they stand

  • Help shape how Customer Success works at Sona, from health scoring to escalation

Requirements

  • You've owned a book of enterprise SaaS accounts, whether as a CSM, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales, Implementation Consultant or PM

  • You've held Director-level customer relationships independently and been accountable for the customer health that drives renewal

  • You're commercially fluent around NRR and value realisation, and treat accounts as long-term assets

  • You're confident in complex SaaS products: you can demo, discuss configuration trade-offs and translate capability into business value

  • You've worked in a scaleup where process was still being built

  • You use AI tools daily in your CS work and can point to specific workflows

  • You can disagree with a senior customer and keep the relationship intact

It’d be a bonus if you could bring

Nach der Einarbeitung: Du bearbeitest die üblichen Anliegen selbstständig, übernimmst telefonische Kontakte und klärst komplexere Fälle mit den zuständigen Fachleuten.

Ein Plus sind Erfahrungen mit Ticketsystemen, Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie, Kundenbindung oder Tarifberatung. Auch Kenntnisse rund um Websites, Online-Shops und Datenschutz helfen dir beim Einstieg.

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt, deine Verlässlichkeit und die Bereitschaft, dich in unsere Produkte einzuarbeiten.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt
