Participate in new business pitches, helping to develop data and tech solutions that demonstrate the value of WPP Media’s capabilities. Coordinate with third-party vendors for the assessment and management of bespoke measurement solutions, including contracts and SOWs.

Thought Leaderhsip: Translate complex data concepts for stakeholders and contribute to the company's data strategy, promoting data-driven innovation within the media industry.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team, using project management tools such as Jira/Trello. Ability to project manage analytics projects.

  • Strong understanding of what data points can be collected and analysed in a digital campaign, and how each data point should be analysed. Including knowledge of media data and incremental measurement, including both Direct Response and Brand campaigns

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle — from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate.

Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development.

Success in this role will be measured by meaningful and sustained Codex adoption, successful customer outcomes, and the creation of repeatable technical patterns that help engineering organizations get more value from AI.

This role is open in our Munich and Berlin offices. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Chez Hubvisory, on veut une équipe Design qui pense comme ça, et on cherche la personne qui va la faire grandir.

descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Lead to establish Rivia’s marketing function and build a reliable channel for qualified pipeline generation. You will shape our brand identity as a credible, emerging AI-native technology company transforming clinical trials, while owning both strategy and execution across product marketing, events, field marketing and targeted campaigns.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Client Solutions and Strategic Partnerships. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has experienced excellent marketing execution in a scaling company and is excited to build with limited resources, move quickly and own commercial outcomes.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration

You will own marketing strategy, messaging, programs, execution, brand visibility and performance reporting. Marketing is accountable for marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced qualified pipeline, with attribution agreed jointly with Sales. Sales owns opportunities, deal progression and closing.

You will partner with Strategic Partnerships on coordinated programs, with Product on market-facing narratives and launches, and with industry experts on thought leadership. You will recommend budget allocations for CEO approval and manage specialist agencies while retaining ownership of strategy and quality.

What excites you:

  • Building a marketing function from the ground up and setting a high standard for execution.

  • Turning complex clinical trial technology into clear, compelling stories for biotech buyers.

  • Creating memorable events, targeted campaigns and original ways to engage hard-to-reach decision-makers.

  • Combining strategic judgment with hands-on delivery, from copy and briefs to vendors and follow-up.

  • Being measured by qualified pipeline and commercial impact rather than vanity metrics.

  • Working with ambitious colleagues in a fast-moving Series A environment, with autonomy and direct access to the CEO.

What You’ll Do

  • Refine positioning, value propositions, buyer-specific messaging and competitive differentiation with Product.

  • Own product launches end to end, coordinating launch assets, website updates, PR, sales enablement and customer proof points.

  • Select high-value conferences and field initiatives based on target accounts and opportunity potential.

  • Own event strategy, budgets, vendors, logistics, invitations, meeting programs and follow-up; organize Rivia-hosted events and an annual customer launch day.

  • Develop creative, targeted programs that connect decision-maker engagement to qualified opportunities.

  • Run targeted LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns in coordination with Sales and Strategic Partnerships.

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and external agencies with clear briefs, timelines and quality standards.

  • Establish marketing reporting, pipeline attribution and a lean operating rhythm; direct spending toward measurable results.

  • Build differentiated brand visibility and thought leadership with input from colleagues and industry experts.

What excites us:

  • Substantial experience in high-growth B2B technology scale-ups or unicorns, ideally through a meaningful scaling phase.

  • Approximately 5 to 10 years of relevant experience, with demonstrated scope and impact more important than a rigid number of years.

  • Hands-on ownership across at least two of product marketing, events, field marketing and GTM campaigns.

  • Evidence of measurable contribution to qualified pipeline, not only brand awareness, traffic or attendance.

  • Excellent project management, stakeholder communication and agency coordination.

  • Strong strategic GTM judgment, creativity, resourcefulness, urgency and personal ownership.

  • Ability to position complex technical products and operate as a senior individual contributor without a large team.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience marketing complex enterprise SaaS, data, AI or scientific technology with long sales cycles.

  • Experience with account-based GTM and enterprise buyers in both the US and Europe.

  • Exposure to biotech, pharma or clinical development.

  • Experience directing PR, content and design specialists while retaining responsibility for outcomes.

  • A track record of building repeatable, efficient marketing programs from scratch.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

  • In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

  • Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

  • Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

  • Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

  • Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

  • Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

title: Marketing Specialist (m/f/d) - Promotion & Events with a passion for aviation
descriptionHtml:

You will shape the external perception of AutoGyro, strengthen the positioning of our brand and products, and create exceptional experiences for customers, partners and other relevant stakeholders.

Your focus lies on strategic marketing communications, PR, brand development, promotion and events. You combine strategic thinking with a strong sense of aesthetics, premium positioning and commercial awareness.

Join our dynamic team and play an active part in our company’s success. You can look forward to attractive terms and conditions, as well as a free lunch every day.

Tasks

  • Drive the implementation of the strategic vision and objectives defined by the Head of Sales & Marketing
  • Development and implementation of marketing and communications activities in line with the overall business strategy
  • Strengthening and further development of the AutoGyro brand and its positioning in relevant markets
  • Development and implementation of PR, media relations and brand storytelling activities
  • Planning and execution of promotional campaigns and initiatives to increase brand awareness and market presence
  • Conceptualization and execution of premium events, trade shows, customer experiences and other promotional activities
  • Development of compelling brand experiences and experiential marketing concepts such as “The Art of Flying”
  • Identification and development of relevant partnerships, cooperation opportunities and business development initiatives
  • Management of awards submissions and other opportunities to increase brand visibility
  • Development of merchandising concepts and a consistent, premium-oriented brand environment
  • Acting as a brand ambassador and spokesperson in selected channels and at relevant events
  • Supporting the Head of Sales at official events, customer meetings, international appointments and other external activities
  • Close collaboration with Sales and other internal stakeholders on brand, communication and business development topics
  • Monitoring relevant market, luxury, lifestyle and aviation trends and translating insights into marketing and business opportunities
  • Supporting the development of communication materials, campaigns and content across relevant channels

Requirements

  • Degree in Marketing, Communications, PR, Media, Business or a comparable qualification
  • Professional experience in marketing, communications, PR, events or a comparable field
  • Strong expertise in Brand Communication, PR, Storytelling and promotional activities
  • Experience in event management and the creation of engaging customer experiences
  • Strong understanding of brand development and commercial positioning
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both German and English
  • Confident and professional appearance when representing the company externally
  • Creative mindset combined with strong organizational and project management skills
  • Structured, independent and hands-on working style with a high sense of quality
  • Willingness to travel for customer events, trade shows and official appointments
  • Experience in luxury, premium brands, aviation, lifestyle or high-end technical products is a strong plus
  • Experience in business development, strategic partnerships or merchandising is a plus
  • Passion for aviation!

Application Task

To ensure a fair and comparable assessment of all applicants, the following task is part of the application process:

  • Social Media Post: Create a fictional social media post for a platform of your choice promoting AutoGyro’s participation as an exhibitor at a major international trade fair. The objective is to attract attention, generate interest and encourage visitors to visit the AutoGyro booth.
  • Video Reel: Create a short video reel, e.g. for Instagram, that conveys the beauty and fascination of flying in an emotional way and presents the AutoGyro brand in a visually appealing manner.

Please note: Applications submitted without completing the required task cannot be considered, as the task is an integral part of the selection process and allows us to assess all applicants on a comparable basis.

Benefits

  • Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.
  • Supportive and international team culture.
  • Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.
  • Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).
  • Employer contributions to the pension scheme.
  • Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
  • Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
  • Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
  • Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
  • Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.

Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then join AutoGyro GmbH.

We are the world market leader in the development, production and sale of gyrocopters and work with partners in more than 40 countries. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high degree of vertical integration and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we are actively shaping the future.

Since our foundation in 1999, we have grown steadily and now employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. Through our global sales network, we are consistently pursuing our goal: to bring the thrill of flying, maximum safety and the versatile applications of the Gyro to people all over the world.

title: Mechanical Engineer – CAD & Engineering Support (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

About the Role

As a Mechanical Engineer – CAD & Engineering Support, you’ll produce high-quality mechanical models, drawings, and engineering documentation across Focused Energy’s projects. This is a hands-on role focused on translating design intent into accurate, well-structured CAD outputs that support manufacture, supplier engagement, assembly, and project delivery.

You’ll work across a range of technically demanding systems, including laser systems, vacuum equipment, diagnostic mounting structures, and facility mechanical infrastructure. Working closely with senior mechanical engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, you’ll provide practical design support while helping maintain consistent CAD standards, drawing conventions, and engineering documentation across the team.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop detailed 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using Autodesk Inventor or an equivalent 3D CAD tool.

  • Produce manufacturing drawings, assembly drawings, layout models, parts lists, BOMs, and drawing registers to a high engineering standard.

  • Maintain and update CAD models and associated documentation as designs evolve throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support the design and development of mechanical systems such as vacuum chambers, laser system integration, diagnostic structures, and facility infrastructure.

  • Identify and resolve design clashes, interface issues, documentation gaps, and inconsistencies within CAD assemblies.

  • Prepare complete drawing packages and technical documentation for supplier quotation, manufacture, procurement, and design reviews.

  • Review supplier drawings and documentation, support the resolution of technical queries, and communicate design status and outstanding actions clearly.

  • Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, controls, and systems engineers to support integration activities and maintain accurate assembly models.

Who You Are

  • You are a capable mechanical engineer who can translate design intent into accurate models, drawings, and structured engineering documentation.

  • You have a highly detail-oriented and methodical approach to CAD modelling, drawing production, and document control.

  • You can manage multiple drawing and documentation tasks across concurrent projects while maintaining quality and delivery focus.

  • You communicate clearly with senior engineers, suppliers, manufacturers, and multidisciplinary project teams.

  • You proactively identify design clashes, interface risks, incomplete information, and documentation gaps before they affect delivery.

  • You take ownership of your outputs and follow through on actions, revisions, technical queries, and design updates.

  • You are comfortable working in a collaborative engineering environment and adapting to different project disciplines and technical requirements.

  • You are committed to applying engineering standards, CAD conventions, and version-control practices consistently.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience with vacuum systems, chambers, precision mechanical assemblies, laser or optical system integration, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Familiarity with PDM or PLM systems, CAD data management, document control, and structured version-control practices.

  • Knowledge of design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA), supplier drawing review, prototype build support, and commissioning activities.

  • Understanding of GD&T and relevant engineering drawing standards, including ISO, DIN, or equivalent conventions.

  • Experience working in experimental physics, research, advanced engineering, or other multidisciplinary technical environments where mechanical systems must be integrated, manufactured, and tested.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Member of Technical Staff – Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
Your team

You will work with the engineers who connect new machines to Lyceum’s systems and build the orchestration layer that lets us move GPUs between use cases. The team’s aim is to get the most out of every GPU we run. Your part in that: service levels for compute that are clearly defined, monitored and alerted on.

Your mission

You will build the observability stack that shows how every layer of Lyceum's platform is doing, from GPU and memory through Kubernetes to the individual inference worker. Your goal is that we see a problem before our customers do, and that we can warn them before their own workloads fail.

Your focus

Observability platform: Build and run the metrics, logs and traces pipelines across all our data centres, and keep them fast and affordable as the fleet grows.

Alerting and incident tooling: Define SLOs with the product teams, build alerts that are precise enough to act on, and provide the tooling for on-call and incident response.

Proactive detection: Analyse system and customer workload behaviour to catch errors before they occur, and turn recurring incidents into automated checks.

Customer-facing visibility: Give customers a clear view of the usage, performance and health of what they run on Lyceum.

Your KPIs

  • Time to detection for incidents

  • Share of incidents detected by monitoring before a customer reports them

  • Alert precision (actionable alerts versus noise)

  • Coverage of platform components with dashboards and SLOs

Your profile

We consider candidates from diverse backgrounds, with a deep love for technical challenges and the desire to take on ownership beyond what's reasonably expected.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in site reliability, observability or infrastructure engineering

  • Production experience with Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry or similar tooling

  • Strong proficiency in Go and Python

  • Strong systems fundamentals: Linux, networking and Kubernetes

  • Experience defining SLOs and building alerting that teams trust

Nice to have

  • Experience with GPU telemetry and inference serving metrics (time to first token, throughput)

  • Experience monitoring multi-cluster or multi-region systems

  • Familiarity with model serving frameworks such as vLLM

  • Comfortable working on-call or in incident response when things break

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

title: Mission Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Mission Operations Manager

Run the field exercises that put SE3's autonomous systems in the hands of military units, and bring back the insight that shapes what we build next.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Mission Operations team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Mission Operations Manager, you'll plan and run the exercises and trials that prove SE3's autonomous systems and Spatial AI in realistic conditions. You'll be the day-to-day point of contact for the operational units we work with, partnering closely with our engineering, product and commercial teams and travelling regularly across Europe. What you capture in the field becomes the evidence and requirements that move our product and programmes forward.

What You'll Work On

  • Exercise Planning: Plan trials and exercises within our exercise programme, from component tests through to multi-system exercises, with clear scenarios, objectives and success criteria.

  • Exercise Delivery: Run exercises on the ground, coordinating the people, systems and logistics involved so that each one delivers usable results.

  • User Liaison: Act as the day-to-day contact for operational units. Build trusted working relationships and keep a steady flow of feedback between users and SE3.

  • Operational Assessment: Assess how our systems perform in realistic conditions and document their operational value, limitations and integration needs in clear post-exercise reports.

  • Requirements Capture: Translate user feedback and field observations into structured requirements that product and engineering can prioritise and act on.

  • Programme Support: Supply the commercial team with operational evidence, demonstrations and field insight that help turn engagement into awarded programmes.

  • Team Building: Help establish the processes, templates and ways of working that let the Mission Operations team scale as SE3 grows.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of outcomes and get things done without waiting for direction. You turn plans into well-run activities and hold yourself to a consistently high standard.

  • You bring several years of experience in military operations, trials or capability development, ideally as a serving or former officer or NCO, or in a field or trials role with a defence supplier.

  • You have a solid technical understanding of unmanned systems, autonomy or software-defined defence, and engage credibly with both engineers and operators.

  • You're highly organised and comfortable running complex activities with many moving parts, often outdoors and under time pressure.

  • You communicate clearly and build trust quickly with military users, partners and internal teams.

  • You're willing to travel regularly across Europe and into other markets where SE3 operates.

  • You speak native-level German and have full professional fluency in English, written and spoken. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and hold the security clearance required for this role.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Experience planning or running military exercises, trials or experimentation campaigns involving unmanned or autonomous systems.

  • Hands-on experience operating drones, with EU UAS operator certificates a plus.

  • Experience in NATO or other multinational exercise environments.

  • Familiarity with defence procurement and how operational trials lead to funded programmes.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3's growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let's get to know each other.

  2. Exercise Planning Case: We share a realistic scenario and ask you to outline how you would plan and run a trial around it.

  3. Deep-Dive Interview (1 hr): We walk through your case, your operational background and your experience running trials and working with military users.

  4. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

title: Multibody Dynamics Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented and experienced Mechanism Engineer to help us in our mission by designing, manufacturing, testing and delivering, fully inhouse mechanisms for Nyx. The candidate will be responsible for performing multibody dynamic simulation analysis and structural analysis for components and systems. They’ll need a strong understanding of kinematics, statics, material mechanics, stress, and mass properties.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the multibody dynamic analysis across the Nyx program to drive design aspects of the program and systems/subsystems teams.

  • Model, simulate, and verify the Nyx vehicle level separation kinematics/dynamics from the launch vehicle, as well as the capsule to service module separation.

  • Perform kinematic analysis of deployment, release, and articulated systems, including motion envelopes, clearances, and interference checks.

  • Support testing and use test data to correlate simulation models.

  • Perform Finite Element Model (FEM) analysis on various subsystems and their components to assess strength, stiffness, and margins of safety.

  • Perform acceleration, shock, and random and sine vibration, and derive environmental requirements for components.

  • Document analysis results in clear reports and present them at design reviews and to stakeholders.

  • Develop reusable analysis methods, tools, and automation for current and future programs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role as Mechanical Analysis Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • MSc or PhD in Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in mechanical analysis, preferably in aerospace, space, or automotive.

  • Demonstrated expertise in multibody dynamics and kinematics using tools such as MSC Adams, Matlab Simscape, or Modelica

  • Proficiency in FEA for linear and nonlinear structural analysis, using tools such as Hypermesh, MSC Nastran, Abaqus, or Ansys.

  • Solid understanding of statics, dynamics, material mechanics, stress analysis, and mass properties.

  • Experience with shock, vibration, and acoustic analysis, including random vibration and shock response spectrum (SRS) methods.

  • Experience correlating simulation models with test data.

Skills and Behaviors

descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on building advanced perception systems that enable autonomous aircraft to operate effectively in complex and contested environments. A successful candidate will be skilled in developing real-time object detection, sensor fusion, and state estimation algorithms using data from diverse mission sensors such as EO/IR cameras, radars, and IMUs.

 

The role requires strong algorithmic thinking, deep familiarity with airborne sensing systems, and the ability to deliver performant software in simulation and real-world conditions. Our Perception Engineers are instrumental in creating the situational awareness that underpins autonomy, ensuring our systems understand and respond to the operational environment with speed, precision, and resilience. 

What you’ll do:

  • Develop advanced perception algorithms — Design and implement robust algorithms for object detection, classification, and multi-target tracking across diverse sensor modalities.

  • Implement sensor fusion frameworks — Integrate data from vision systems, radars, and other mission sensors using probabilistic and deterministic fusion techniques to generate accurate situational awareness.

  • Develop state estimation capabilities — Design and refine algorithms for localization and pose estimation using IMU, GPS, vision, and other onboard sensing inputs to enable stable and accurate navigation.

  • Analyze and utilize sensor ICDs — Interpret interface control documents (ICDs) and technical specifications for aircraft-mounted sensors to ensure correct data handling, interpretation, and synchronization.

  • Optimize perception performance — Tune and evaluate perception pipelines for performance, robustness, and real-time efficiency in both simulation and real-world environments.

  • Support autonomy integration — Work closely with autonomy, systems, and integration teams to interface perception outputs with planning, behaviors, and decision-making modules.

  • Validate in simulated and operational settings — Leverage synthetic data, simulation environments, and field testing to validate algorithm accuracy and mission readiness.

  • Collaborate with hardware and sensor teams — Ensure seamless integration of perception algorithms with onboard compute platforms and diverse sensor payloads.

  • Drive innovation in airborne sensing — Contribute novel ideas and state-of-the-art techniques to advance real-time perception capabilities for unmanned aircraft operating in complex, GPS-denied, or contested environments.

  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10-15% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

title: Office Manager
descriptionHtml:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

As our Office Manager in Munich, you'll have an incredible role as a people driven person who's passionate about the day to day operations and administrative needs of the office, to helping curate a best in class workplace environment and assisting on events.

  • You’ve worked at a startup. You’ve been through the speed and the ambiguity, and the “we’re doubling headcount next quarter” moments. You know how to build processes without slowing anyone down.

  • You care how the office feels. You notice the small things: the coffee, the light, how a new joiner’s first morning goes, whether the meeting rooms actually work. You want people to come in because they’d rather be there.

  • You’re an operator at heart. You’ve managed vendors, facilities, supplies, budgets, health and safety, access and maintenance, and you keep it all running smoothly in the background.

  • You can run events. You’ve planned team socials, all-hands, offsites, investor visits and community nights. You can take one from a rough idea to a polished event, often with little notice.

  • You’re very organised and you follow through. You juggle a dozen moving parts, and nothing gets dropped or waits on someone else to chase it.

  • You’re a great communicator. You build good relationships with everyone, from new engineers to the founders, landlords and suppliers. People find you warm, approachable and dependable.

  • You’re happy owning things alone. You don’t need a playbook. You see what’s needed, set a high bar and get it done.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Operations Assistant
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Operations Assistant to support our Head of Operations with organizing and coordinating the team. You will help keep priorities, meetings, information and follow-ups clear, and help the team stay aligned as our site and production organization grow.

This is a junior, hands-on role for someone who is organized, dependable and eager to learn. You will work closely with the Head of Operations, gain a broad view of how the business runs, and take on more responsibility as you build confidence and experience.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the Head of Operations with day-to-day team organization, priorities and follow-through.

  • Coordinate team meetings and check-ins, including calendars, agendas, notes and action tracking.

  • Maintain clear task lists and team schedules, follow up with owners and flag delays or conflicting priorities early.

  • Help the Head of Operations communicate plans, updates and changes clearly to the team.

  • Support onboarding and training coordination for new team members, including practical arrangements and keeping relevant records up to date.

  • Coordinate day-to-day operational needs such as supplies, deliveries, site visits and service appointments with the appropriate team members.

  • Prepare simple status updates, team documents and presentations using information from the relevant owners.

  • Notice recurring coordination problems and help improve team routines, templates and ways of working.

  • Take on small operational tasks and improvement projects, with guidance from the Head of Operations.

What we are looking for

  • 0–3 years of experience in administration, team coordination, operations support, customer service, a working-student role or a similar setting. Relevant internships and practical experience count; extensive experience is not expected.

  • Strong organization and follow-through: you keep track of details, close loops and make sure agreed actions do not get lost.

  • A helpful, reliable and proactive approach. You are comfortable reaching out, asking questions and following up with people respectfully.

  • Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to handle changing priorities calmly.

  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, especially Outlook, Excel, Word and Teams.

  • Discretion when handling confidential business and team information.

  • Motivation to learn how an operations team works and to take on more responsibility over time.

  • Fluent German; English is strongly preferred for day-to-day coordination with local suppliers and the site team.

  • A completed vocational qualification, relevant training or equivalent practical experience is welcome, but not essential if you can demonstrate the skills above.

Desirable experience

  • Supporting a team lead or manager with coordination, meeting preparation or action follow-up.

  • Experience with calendars, schedules, onboarding or training coordination.

  • Familiarity with task trackers, project tools or an ERP system.

  • Exposure to manufacturing, engineering, logistics, construction or another hands-on environment.

  • Experience from an internship, working-student role, volunteer role or student organization where you helped organize a team or activity.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: People Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Conveo

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.


The Context

Conveo is scaling from $4M to $50M, and the People team is running on goodwill and late nights. We have a recruiting team and a new L&D hire joining, but nobody owns the processes and systems underneath them. Compensation schemes, performance cycles and salary reviews all land on Claudia, alongside the daily operational load.

That has to change before we grow further. You'll be the first dedicated People Operations hire, reporting to Claudia. You'll build the operating system for the whole People function: the tools, data, cycles and lifecycle processes that let us hire, pay, develop and support people well across the UK, Belgium and the US.

You'll work closely with Finance on payroll and compensation, with recruiting and L&D on the employee lifecycle, and with managers across the company. When you've done this well, Claudia spends her time on strategy and growing the team, not on firefighting.

Your Mission

1. Own the People systems stack and make it work across every country

You decide how our People tools fit together, then make them run. Today that spans an HRIS, EOR and PEO providers, and payroll across several geographies.

  • Own the HRIS as the single source of truth for every employee, contractor and EOR hire

  • Lead a possible payroll migration end to end: vendor choice, data cleanup, parallel runs, cutover

  • Manage EOR and PEO relationships across the UK, Belgium and the US

  • Connect systems so data flows once, not through spreadsheets and copy-paste

  • Use AI and automation to remove manual admin wherever it adds no judgement

2. Build an employee lifecycle that feels effortless at 2x our size

Every hire, move and exit should follow a clear, repeatable path that works in any country we operate in.

  • Design onboarding, internal moves and offboarding flows with recruiting and L&D

  • Turn tribal knowledge into documented processes and self-serve answers

  • Keep contracts, documents and policies consistent across geographies

  • Make the experience good for employees and managers, not just compliant

3. Run the people cycles the company depends on

Performance reviews, compensation and salary increases should run on time, every time, without pulling Claudia into the detail.

  • Own the performance cycle calendar, tooling and manager enablement

  • Run compensation projects and salary review cycles with Claudia and Finance

  • Keep bands, levels and approvals applied consistently

  • Spot what slowed each cycle down and fix it before the next one

4. Turn People data into decisions

Leadership should be able to answer people questions in minutes, with numbers they trust.

  • Build reliable reporting on headcount, attrition, compensation and cycle completion

  • Keep People data clean enough to support planning and board reporting

  • Give Claudia and managers the insight to act early, not after the fact

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • 5+ years in People Operations, including time at a startup or scaleup through hypergrowth, with hands-on experience across multiple countries (ideally Belgium and the UK)

  • Hands-on experience scaling a People function: you've seen what breaks between 50 and 200+ people and helped fix it

  • Strong systems thinking: you design processes and tool stacks that hold up as the company grows, not one-off fixes

  • Hands-on experience implementing an HRIS (Deel is a big plus) and running at least one people cycle (performance, comp review or onboarding) end to end.

  • Comfort working with data: you can build a report leadership trusts, and you notice when the numbers look wrong

Mindset

  • High agency, low ego

  • A builder first: you'd rather design the system than run the same manual process twice

  • Pragmatic about risk: you treat compliance as a baseline, not the whole job

  • Ready to step up and own things you've seen done but haven't led yourself

  • Calm and organised when several cycles land at once

Nice to have

  • Real curiosity about AI, ideally with automations or AI tools you've already put to work in People ops

  • Multi-country experience, including the US

  • Payroll experience, especially a payroll provider migration

  • Compensation management experience: bands, reviews and benchmarking

What Success Looks Like

After 6 to 12 months, because you're here:

  • Claudia spends most of her time on People strategy and growing the team, not on daily operations

  • The HRIS is the single source of truth, and nobody keeps a shadow spreadsheet

  • Payroll, EOR and PEO run smoothly across the UK, Belgium and the US, with any payroll migration landed cleanly

  • The last performance and salary review cycles ran on schedule, with clear manager guidance and no last-minute scrambles

  • Every hire, move and exit follows a documented process that works in each country

  • Leadership gets headcount, attrition and comp reporting on demand, from data they trust

  • The People operating system is ready for the next stage of growth, and you're taking on special projects that improve how Conveo works

Why Join Conveo?

At Conveo, you'll join a team that genuinely enjoys working, and spending time, together. We care about building real relationships, not just great products. That's why we run quarterly team offsites where we disconnect, reset, and have fun.

  • Own a high-impact role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

  • Build the People operating system from the ground up, with the room to make it yours

  • Direct access to founders and senior leadership

  • Work with world-class enterprise clients (Unilever, Google, P&G, Orange, and more)

  • Hybrid working model with offices in London, Antwerp, and New York

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition

Compensation: £60K – £80K • Offers Equity

descriptionHtml:

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join People Ops, the Systems and Operations pillar of the People team. It owns payroll, HRIS, onboarding and offboarding, contracts, benefits, and compliance across France, the US, and our remote geographies. You'll report to Melissa, our Senior Global HR Systems and Operations Manager in Paris. We're opening this role because Vibe is scaling fast across regions, and payroll plus People Ops now need a dedicated owner who keeps the engine running and makes it better. If you want real ownership of payroll from day one, a front-row seat to how an international team actually operates across three geographies, and the room to reshape and automate the work as you go, this is the seat.

What You'll Do

Payroll and contractors

  • Run the monthly French payroll cycle with our external provider, from variable inputs to final validation.

  • Check every payslip before sign-off to catch errors before they reach employees.

  • Keep EOR payroll on schedule across our remote geographies.

  • Own contractor operations end to end, from timesheet collection to the Finance provisioning file.

People operations and HR admin

  • Run onboarding and offboarding logistics so every joiner and leaver lands cleanly.

Employee support

  • Serve as first point of contact for employees on People questions.

  • Triage incoming requests through our ticketing system against agreed SLAs.

  • Research individual employee cases across policy, contracts, and local labour law.

Systems and projects

  • Maintain HRIS data hygiene and the workflows behind it.

  • Drive People Ops projects end to end, with clear scope, deadlines, and stakeholders.

What You Need

  • 3+ years in payroll, HR administration, or People Ops. An apprenticeship or internship counts.

  • Strong knowledge of French payroll and labour law fundamentals: contracts, absences, final pay, health and provident cover.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and real comfort working with numbers.

  • Project management basics: you've run something with a real deadline and a scope that moved.

  • Experience with an HRIS.

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience in a ticketing tool.

  • Exposure to international or EOR payroll.

  • Comfort building automations to cut manual work.

  • Experience at a scale-up.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  • Take-home assignment + live debrief — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

  • Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Platform Account Executive, Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 


How you'll make impact

You’ll help businesses bring financial services directly into their own products, using Airwallex’s embedded finance infrastructure to support their customers across markets. You’ll own complex, consultative sales cycles from prospecting and discovery through commercial negotiation, contract signature and launch.

  • Build relationships with vertical SaaS companies, marketplaces, fintechs and other platforms.

  • Help customers embed accounts, payments, payouts, FX and cards into their products.

  • Understand each customer’s business model, platform architecture and money flows, then shape a clear commercial proposition.

  • Navigate technical integrations, onboarding, compliance requirements and multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Build pipeline across the UK/I enterprise market through account research, outbound prospecting, referrals, industry networks and targeted engagement.

  • Work closely with SDRs, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, Operations and Account Management to develop business cases, run technical workshops and support a strong handover into implementation.

  • Contribute to the embedded finance sales playbook by sharing customer insight, competitive context and deal learnings.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Five years of sales experience, ideally in complex B2B, enterprise or technical sales.

  • Experience owning consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and technical or API-enabled products.

  • Strong discovery, commercial negotiation, presentation and deal-orchestration skills.

  • The ability to understand a customer’s business model, platform architecture and money flows, then translate complex requirements into a clear commercial proposition.

  • A track record of building pipeline, progressing opportunities and closing deals through ambiguity and long sales cycles.

  • The confidence to engage stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Customer Success.

Preferred

  • Payments experience in fintech, particularly with embedded finance, platforms, marketplaces, acquiring, payouts or issuing.

  • Experience selling to platform customers such as vertical SaaS companies, fintechs or marketplaces.

  • Experience selling APIs, financial infrastructure, banking-as-a-service, payment infrastructure or other technical products.

  • Around five or more years of experience in enterprise or strategic sales.

  • Experience navigating longer, technical sales cycles with multiple decision-makers and implementation dependencies.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbersYou're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

Our Enterprise team helps large, often multinational organisations solve complex financial challenges. We’ve segmented the team by the problems they solve with our customers - moving money globally and managing treasury operations internally with our Spend solution, and embedding financial services across borders to expand their product offering for their customers with our Platform solution. This role will focus on the latter, helping customers understand what is possible with third-party embedded financial services, but will work closely with other roles who focus on first-party financial operations.

It’s a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic, value-driven thinking with deep product knowledge. We are comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and ambiguity in processes. We are autonomous in our approach, taking ownership of our day to day approach and success, while working collaboratively within the team for best practices. We represent ourselves and the team with integrity and thoughtfulness, working cross-functionally in a respectful and cooperative manner. If you want to work on technically complex high-consequence deals that genuinely impact how customers go to market, this is the place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Platform Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next. 

Role Summary  

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Platform Reliability Engineer is part of the team that operates the platform services Firmus AI Cloud runs on in production: the GPU compute fleet, exabyte-scale storage, the multi-tenant control and management plane, and the virtualisation and shared services that host it. Together, these are the foundation every customer workload depends on.

This is a hands-on site reliability engineering role that works across the stack, from Linux and Kubernetes to storage, virtualisation and the compute fleet. The team runs each service to a declared service level, measures reliability against it, and treats operations as a software problem, engineering repetitive manual work out of the system rather than absorbing it. The role picks up incidents escalated from first response, owns each one through to resolution, and works across teams and vendors to restore service, bringing in specialist engineers when a fault needs deeper investigation. Automation is a first-class part of the role: faults are diagnosed using the observability stack, post-incident reviews feed fixes back into the platform, and every resolved fault is a candidate for a runbook or an automated fix.

Key Responsibilities

  • Triage, diagnose and resolve incidents across the stack, including Kubernetes clusters and workloads, storage, virtualisation, network connectivity and the underlying Linux hosts, owning each incident from escalation through to resolution.
  • Operate the multi-tenant control and management plane that Firmus' AI and infrastructure services depend on, including the tenancy, quota and access controls that support separation between tenant workloads and data.
  • Operate the virtualisation platform that hosts the management plane, and the shared services that run on it, to their declared service levels.
  • Operate Firmus' exabyte-scale distributed and high-performance filesystems and S3-compatible object storage to their declared service levels, handling capacity, performance and availability incidents and escalating to specialist engineers and vendors (for example VAST or WEKA) with clear evidence when further investigation is needed.
  • Operate the GPU compute fleet in production: node health and readiness, GPU and node fault detection and handling, firmware and driver currency to the supported baselines, remediation and return to service, and support for cluster provisioning and validation activities.
  • Reduce toil by converting repeat fixes into runbooks and automated remediation delivered as controlled code, contributing to the team's automation and remediation tooling.
  • Diagnose performance problems across the data path between compute and storage, gathering the evidence needed to resolve them and working with network and storage specialists where required.
  • Deliver change as code through the agreed change process, with peer review, testing, staged rollout where applicable, and a rollback plan.
  • Use the observability stack (for example Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and Tempo) to track service level indicators against their objectives, query metrics, logs and traces, correlate signals across services and diagnose faults, and improve dashboards and alerting so that each alert is actionable and tied to a runbook.
  • Execute the patching cycle and urgent vulnerability remediation across the services the team operates.
  • Manage vendor support cases across the hardware and software portfolio, raising and tracking cases under the relevant support agreements, supplying logs and diagnostic evidence, and following cases through to agreed response and resolution times.
  • Take part in technical recovery during major incidents and in blameless post-incident reviews, feed recurring issues back to the engineering teams as clear requirements, share the follow-the-sun on-call roster, and keep incident tickets, operational procedures and runbooks accurate and current so that others can execute them successfully.

Skills & Experience 

Required Skills

  • Solid experience operating production infrastructure in a 24/7 environment using site reliability engineering practices, including service level objectives, toil reduction, owning incidents from escalation to resolution, oncall participation, post-incident review and writing runbooks that others can execute successfully.
  • Strong working knowledge of Linux systems administration and troubleshooting, including storage, host networking, processes, memory and I/O, and a systematic approach to isolating faults.
  • Working experience with scale-out, parallel or enterprise storage (for example VAST, WEKA, Ceph, Lustre, GPFS or NetApp), including diagnosing performance and capacity problems using evidence rather than assumption.
  • Familiarity with a virtualisation platform (for example Proxmox, VMware or KVM).
  • Working experience using observability tooling to diagnose faults (for example Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo or Elasticsearch), including writing queries across metrics and logs (such as PromQL and LogQL) and correlating signals across services.
  • Working experience with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices (for example OpenTofu or Terraform, Ansible, Argo CD), and writing scripts or small tools for operational automation in a language such as Python or Go.
  • Familiarity with server hardware operation and support, including working with hardware and software vendors to raise support cases and supply diagnostic evidence.Platform Reliability Engineer
  • Familiarity with cyber security principles and how they apply to operating production infrastructure.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to write incident updates, ticket notes and escalations that others can act on, and a working style suited to a team that shares accountability for a broad portfolio across regions.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience in infrastructure operations for GPU or HPC environments and the demands of large-scale distributed training and inference, including GPU health and fault signals (for example DCGM health checks, NCCL tests and XID errors).
  • Experience in multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environments with contractual response commitments and customer-facing reporting.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VLANs, load balancing and firewalls, and the ability to trace a connectivity fault across hosts, switches and services.
  • Knowledge of high-performance fabrics and data-path technologies, such as InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA and GPUDirect Storage, and DPU or SmartNIC-based networking.
  • Familiarity with bare-metal lifecycle and provisioning automation (for example NVIDIA Infra Controller, MAAS, Ironic or Metal3), and standard operating environments with known good-state enforcement.
  • Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting Kubernetes, including workloads, networking, storage and cluster health, and multi-tenant and GPU-enabled Kubernetes patterns.
  • Experience with ITSM and incident management tooling (for example Jira Service Management, ServiceNow or PagerDuty).
  • Experience working under ISO 27001 or SOC 2 controls.
  • Relevant certification, such as Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), a Linux certification (for example RHCSA or LFCS), or a vendor certification.
  • A Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and training.

Location & Reporting 

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required. 

On-call: The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role shares the after-hours escalation roster for its domain with the other senior engineers in the function. 

Reporting to:  Reports to the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations while the function is being established, working under broad direction with a high degree of autonomy and direct access to the decision makers. As the function reaches its planned structure, the role will report to the Infrastructure Operations Manager, with the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations remaining accountable for the function. The scope, level and remit of the role do not change under either arrangement. 

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.
