title: Robot Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

  • The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

  • Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of relevant full-time robotics experience.

  • PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

  • You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

  • You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists.

  • Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim..

  • Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise.

  • AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was.

  • Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2.

What success looks like in 90 days

You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like.

Are we a good fit?

Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit?.

What we offer

  • The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one

  • A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets

  • Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started

  • Benefits — see what we offer

Are you in?

Instead of a cover letter: pick a published human-video-to-robot-policy pipeline you rate, and tell us where it breaks on a warehouse floor where every hand wears a work glove.

title: Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Checkout.com is actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Payments Sales Manager to join our Commercial Payments Team to drive rapid growth across various industries for our revolutionary online payment solution.

 

If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of success selling direct payment solutions to enterprise companies, in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivaled uncapped recurring commissions plan, hybrid work model and competitive benefits package.

 

The Sales Executive will play a key role in growing Checkout.com’s payments footprint. They will be responsible for selling Checkout.com’s full payments technology stack to middle market and large enterprise organizations.

 

Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. Desire an independent, high-achieving individual that stands out in an entrepreneurial environment and has the grit and desire to outperform sales targets.

 

How you’ll make impact:
● Acting as a consultative Payments strategist able to advise companies on an optimal payments structure that pulls from a myriad of solutions Checkout.com provides
● Identify, qualify and close the most promising prospects and partners that will help Checkout.com grow a healthy pipeline across various verticals.
● Build prospect engagement strategies and partner with marketing, business development, product and other departments to build qualified that pipeline in cold and warm channels
● Pitch our next-generation payment solutions and value-added services
● Prepare high-quality presentations and proposals for C-suite stakeholders at prospective merchants, and implement winning negotiation strategies
● Become the expert on Checkout.com’s technology stack, help new merchants understand the value of Checkout.com to solve their pain points, and handle detailed questions about our product capabilities.
● Orchestrate the entire Sales process, drive urgency and work to mutual action plans, and act as the main point of contact for merchants and internal stakeholders.
● Maintain a solid, well-organized portfolio and nurture key accounts by having a deep understanding of their industry, pain points, and needs.
● Partner with other Payment Sales Managers to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends.
● Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information.

 

Qualifications:
● 3+ years B2B Sales experience
● Track record of high performance, and self sourcing leads
● Highly motivated and committed to growth and development with excellent communication skills
● Solid network of potential prospects and partners within the payments landscape
● Tech-savvy, with a passion for Fintech and Payments
● Strong commercial acumen, ability to effectively negotiate complex structures

 

Nice to Have:
● Experience directly in the Payments industry

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Sales Planning & Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris or Barcelona area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Senior Account Executive - Financial Crime Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Account Executive to drive new business and expand existing relationships across our Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) solution suite — including AML, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), sanctions screening, and fraud prevention technology — within financial services enterprise accounts. This role is ideal for a seasoned sales professional who combines deep domain expertise in financial crime and regulatory compliance with a proven track record of closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.

The successful candidate will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting through close — engaging C-level and senior compliance, risk, and technology stakeholders at banks, fintechs, payment providers, and other regulated financial institutions across UK&I.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

Enterprise Sales Execution

• Own and drive the full sales cycle for enterprise financial services accounts, from lead qualification to contract close.

• Build and manage a robust pipeline of net-new logos and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

• Consistently meet or exceed quota and revenue targets for AML/FCC compliance solutions.

• Develop and execute account-based sales strategies for top-tier banks, fintechs, payment providers, and financial institutions.

Domain-Driven Selling

• Leverage deep knowledge of AML, KYC, CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, adverse media screening, entity resolution, case management, and regulatory reporting to credibly engage compliance and risk stakeholders.

• Translate complex regulatory requirements and financial crime trends (e.g., sanctions evasion, mule accounts, digital assets, AI-driven financial crime, beneficial ownership transparency) into clear business value propositions.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers, speaking fluently to regulatory pain points and compliance program needs.

• Understanding of positioning AI driven solutions across business, IT and transformation teams.

Executive & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and maintain relationships with senior executives, Chief Compliance Officers, Heads of Financial Crime, risk leaders, and technology decision-makers.

• Lead executive briefings, discovery sessions, and strategic account reviews.

• Partner with customers throughout the buying journey to align solution capabilities to business and regulatory outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver tailored solutions and ensure smooth handoffs post-sale.

• Provide market and customer feedback to Product teams to inform roadmap and competitive positioning.

• Contribute domain expertise to RFP responses, competitive evaluations, and proposal development.

Pipeline & Forecast Management

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date pipeline, forecast, and account data in CRM.

• Provide regular, reliable forecasting to sales leadership.

• Identify and mitigate deal risk through proactive account management.

 

What you'll bring to the team

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• 10+ years of enterprise sales experience selling software/technology solutions into financial services (banks, fintechs, payment providers, insurers, or capital markets firms).

• Extreme depth of knowledge in Financial Crime Compliance — AML, KYC/CDD, sanctions screening, fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and regulatory risk.

• Demonstrated history of success consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

• Proven ability to sell to and influence senior executives, compliance leaders, risk officers, and technology buyers.

• Strong understanding of global AML/FCC regulatory frameworks across UK&I

• Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.

• Experience with enterprise CRM tools (Salesforce or similar) and structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, Command of the Message).

• Ability to travel as needed to support customer meetings and industry events.

title: Senior Accountant
descriptionHtml:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking a driven Senior Accountant who thrives in a fast-moving environment and wants to help shape how Finance works. We want someone who doesn't just run a process the way it has always been run, but asks whether there's a better way and then builds it. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly analytical and possesses strong accounting knowledge. This role blends month-end close ownership with proactive project delivery, continuous improvement, and value-add financial insights. You will focus on transaction accounting, estimate preparation, balance sheet reconciliations, commentary and analysis as well as ad-hoc projects. This is a hands-on role that requires high-autonomy task execution, tackling unexpected complexities as they arise to ensure accurate and timely completion. You are equally effective working both independently and within a team. Modernizing how accounting gets done is a strategic priority for KAYAK and for Controllership, and this role will support it.

This role is based in our London office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Own key parts of the monthly close, including accounting estimates, balance sheet reconciliations and accounting memos, and deliver them at pace.

  • Provide clear P&L and balance sheet commentary that explains what is moving and why, focusing on the key drivers.

  • Spot opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate, and lead those improvements from idea through to implementation.

  • Build strong business partnerships with cross-functional teams (e.g. Commercial, Legal, Payroll, Marketing, Tax) to keep accruals accurate and everyone aligned.

  • Take on ad-hoc analysis and cross-functional projects as they arise, with minimal direction.

  • Support internal and external audits and SOX compliance, partnering with Risk & Controls to maintain strong financial controls as processes evolve.

  • Help coach and develop teammates, and share what you learn along the way.

Modernize how we work, including automation and AI

  • Look for ways to simplify your accounting work, strengthen controls, and reduce manual effort, and bring ideas to your manager. Start with what the process needs to achieve before automating it.

  • Help roll out our automation roadmap and agentic workflows in your areas by testing, giving feedback, and updating procedures, in partnership with Accounting Process Solutions and Enterprise Systems

  • Use approved automation and AI tools to speed up variance analysis, commentary drafts, reconciliations, data validation, and reporting, applying sound accounting judgment, human review, confidentiality, and auditability

  • Keep documentation current when a process or tool changes, and flag any control impact early

  • Ask why work is done the way it is, and share what works (and what doesn’t) with your team.

Please apply if you have:

  • Fully qualified (ACA/ACCA/CA or equivalent) with 3+ years’ post qualification experience with training from a Big 4/mid-tier firm or hands-on in-house GL close experience in a high-growth or multinational business.

  • Strong attention to detail, reliable execution, with sharp judgment on where detail adds genuine value.

  • High-autonomy task execution, tackling unexpected complexities as they arise to ensure complete, accurate and timely delivery. You see what needs doing and get on with it.

  • A track record of driving change, such as automating manual processes, improving workflows or leading finance projects.

  • Proactive mindset with strong initiative, anticipating team needs and tackling emerging challenges before they become blockers.

  • Strong prioritisation skills, adept at balancing speed with precision, knowing when to prioritise timely completion over perfection.

  • Strong analytical thinking and a real interest in what sits behind the numbers.

  • Knowledge of US GAAP is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills. Experience with automation or workflow tools, or an appetite to learn them, is a strong plus.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including with remote colleagues.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
This role is also open to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations.

If you've built something before, start here

Most ML jobs hand you a benchmark. This one hands you a business problem with paying customers and their real data. Construction tenders are long, messy and full of trade jargon, and every decision a customer makes on our platform becomes a labeled example you can train on.

We need someone who can turn that data into models that customers notice: from the first experiment to the model serving production traffic, and back again when a customer says it got something wrong. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first ML engineer somewhere, or shipped a model people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers in Switzerland, Austria and Germany still run their most document-heavy work by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate that work one process at a time, and ML sits at the center of every one of them.

What you'll own

You'll own the ML behind our products, end to end. In practice that means:

  • Training and fine-tuning: embedding models, rerankers, classifiers and LLMs, trained on our own data.

  • Document understanding: models that pull structure, quantities and product specs out of tenders, orders and catalogs.

  • Product matching: retrieval and LLM agents that match tender positions to the right products.

  • Evaluation: offline benchmarks, per-customer evals and gates that keep a new model from shipping if it makes things worse.

  • Training and serving infrastructure: automated retrain pipelines, GPU serving and vector search in production.

  • Customer problems: when a model gets something wrong for a customer, finding out why and fixing it.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a model or part of the pipeline people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next.

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version.

  • A model you trained runs in production, and customers can see the difference in their results.

  • Retraining runs automatically, and nothing reaches customers without passing an eval you designed.

  • You've cut LLM cost or latency by replacing an expensive step with a smaller model of your own.

  • You've decided at least one thing we should stop building.

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a model in production, or a side project with real users.

  • You've trained and fine-tuned models yourself, ideally embeddings, retrieval or document models, and evaluated them honestly on held-out data.

  • You've built with LLMs in production and know where agents fail.

  • You write strong Python and can run what you build: Docker, CI/CD, and cloud on GCP, AWS or Azure.

  • You measure before you believe, and a single aggregate score doesn't convince you.

  • You'd rather open a customer's actual document than wait for a spec.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is.

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title.

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going.

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls.

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

You probably won't enjoy it if

  • You just want to code and go home.

  • You don't like talking to customers.

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you.

  • You want a well-defined research agenda handed to you.

  • You'd rather hand a model to someone else to deploy and debug.

  • Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount.

Our stack

Python and PyTorch, open-weight and frontier LLMs, LangGraph, Langfuse, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, and GCP. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  2. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through a model or system you built, the decisions you made and what went wrong in production.

  3. Meet Scalera Day: come to our office in Zürich, work on a real problem with real (anonymized) tender data, and meet the team.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Zürich HQ, four days in the office, Fridays remote. If not located in Zürich then this role is open to remote within the EU or EEA,

  • Occasional customer visits across Switzerland, Austria and Germany

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity

Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. We read every one.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

De plus, tu auras un rôle central dans la mise à disposition des technologies d'IA générative pour nos développeurs. L’équipe est composée de 4 Platform Engineers et de 2 Product Managers.

  • Industrialisation & IaC : Piloter le déploiement, le maintien et l'évolution de nos infrastructures IA via Terraform, en garantissant une cohérence parfaite entre nos différents environnements Cloud.
  • Automatisation & CI/CD : Optimiser nos cycles de mise en production en orchestrant des pipelines de déploiement continu (CI/CD) via Git, assurant ainsi rapidité et fiabilité.

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. title: Senior Analytics Engineer

💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

 

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We are a mission-driven team of 80 engineers based in London and the surrounding areas, united by the challenge of fixing healthcare communication. title: Senior Applied AI Engineer

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer in Berlin, you’ll lead Resonance’s most ambitious client engagements across DACH. You will design and build production AI systems to drive a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier, own end-to-end deployments, and lead a team of AI engineers to build at pace. You’ll set the technical direction, advising CTOs and engineering leads of leading enterprises and owning security, reliability and governance for everything we put into production. You’ll lead the build from first prototype to production while staying hands-on in the code, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems, and setting the bar for code quality, evals and observability. You’ll grow the firm by building Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning patterns from client work into reusable components, and coaching the engineers on your team as one of our first technical leaders in Berlin.

You write production Python or TypeScript, have designed and shipped LLM systems in production, including agents, retrieval and evals, and design for how they fail. You’ve led engineering teams and raised their bar, make clear decisions under uncertainty, and are commercial and comfortable problem solving with technical and non-technical execs. What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Most engineers get one shot at a startup. Here you build many products, not one: our own AI products and platform, and several production AI systems a year across industries. Your work drives tangible outcomes for consequential companies, alongside a team aiming to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe and worldwide. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm. As one of our early joiners in Berlin, you’ll shape how we build, operate and grow.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.

Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.
  • Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.
  • Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.
  • Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.
  • Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.
  • Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.
  • Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.
  • Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.

Must-haves

  • A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.
  • A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.
  • Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.
  • Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves

  • First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.
  • Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.
  • Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.
  • Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.
  • Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks demonstrating contributions to efficient AI systems.
  • Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.

* Registration as a Veterinary Nurse with the RCVS * Confidence supporting anaesthesia, surgical procedures and peri-operative patient care * Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues * Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities effectively within a busy clinical environment * An interest in supporting, mentoring and developing other members of the nursing team * A proactive approach to learning, reflection and continuous improvement

* A varied and rewarding senior nursing role within a specialist-led equine hospital * Opportunities to develop your theatre, surgical and leadership experience * Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into senior nursing, referral and leadership roles, as well as Clinical Coach, mentoring and certificate pathways * Ongoing learning and development supported by experienced colleagues and specialist clinical teams * A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement

title: Senior Commercial Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made.

STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data.

STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

The role. As a Senior Commercial Product Manager, you own a portfolio of our most important customers. You are responsible for the success of each deployment, for the value it creates for the customer, and for growing the relationship from initial pilot to organisation-wide rollout. You work directly with their C-suite and sales leadership to understand their business model, their commercial priorities, and where untapped growth potential lies across their markets, segments and accounts.

You translate those priorities into what STRATOS delivers. You define what the solution needs to do, work with our engineers to make sure it gets built right, and bring the results back to the customer's decision-makers. You bridge two worlds: the customer's commercial reality and our product.

Your responsibility doesn't end at go-live. You stay at the customer's side as they put the solution to work: challenging their thinking, helping them act on what the data shows, and making sure the impact is visible in their results.

This role suits someone who wants to own outcomes rather than just recommend them. Beyond your own accounts, you help shape the direction of STRATOS – what we build, how we deploy it and how we grow.

The roles you'll play

  • Trusted advisor to the C-suite — work directly with executive teams and sales leadership on where to play, how to win, and how to organise and steer a sales force. You are the person they call before they decide, not after.

  • Owner of the customer, end to end — from first pilot to multi-country rollout, the deployment, the relationship and the results are yours. Our engineers build it; you decide what gets built and you stand behind whether it worked.

  • Commercial owner of your portfolio — you are responsible for its growth: expansion into new use cases and new markets, and the judgement of when a customer is ready for more and when they are not.

  • Product manager for your market — you translate what you see across your customers into our roadmap, define what gets built, and own it with engineering through to release.

  • Builder of the function — you shape how STRATOS deploys and scales: the standards, the tooling and the people. Senior CPMs coach the CPMs around them.

Who this is for. We hire for commercial judgement and the credibility to hold a room of executives. That does not come from one background, and we are open about where yours comes from.

What we're actually looking for:

  • You have owned a complex piece of work end to end — scoping it, aligning stakeholders who disagreed, delivering it, and being accountable for whether it worked. We're interested in people who ran the engagement, not only staffed it.

  • You can hold your own with a commercial director who has run their business for twenty years and change their mind with evidence rather than seniority.

  • You do your own analysis. You are comfortable in the data, and you'd rather check the number yourself than take it from a slide.

  • You can explain something complicated to someone non-technical without making them feel stupid.

  • You are genuinely interested in how industrial businesses make money — pricing, channels, sales coverage, market structure.

  • You want to be somewhere your decisions are visible. At our size, the roadmap changes because of what you bring back.

This is probably not for you if you want a defined remit, a stable set of processes, or a role where strategy and delivery are separate jobs.

What we offer

  • Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

  • A highly competitive salary

  • Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

  • Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

  • Private healthcare

  • Pension scheme

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

  • Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

  • Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

Practicalities

  • London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

  • Travel to some customer sites roughly, mostly within Europe

  • German is useful and several of our customers are German-speaking, but it is not required

The process

  1. First round with our Talent Lead - 30 minutes

  1. Technical case interview - 45 minutes

  1. Hiring manager interview with a senior executive - 30 minutes

  1. Second senior executive interview, which may include a case exercise - 30 minutes

  1. Final stage with our CEO - 45 minutes

title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
descriptionHtml:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  • Project Delivery: Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
  • Work Experience: Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. 
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.
  • Technical Depth: You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

  • Risk & financial integrity. Model risk exposure across a volatile asset book, forecast liquidation risk, and detect reconciliation breaks across internal ledgers, on-chain data and partner reporting.

  • Financial crime & compliance. Detect account takeover, payment fraud and mule networks in real time, combining business rules and models that work together while staying explainable and auditable.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own problems end to end: frame the question with the stakeholder, build the model or experiment, ship it, and follow it into production.

  • Work backwards from the decision. Start from what someone needs to decide and what it costs to get it wrong, not from the data that happens to be available.

  • Stay accountable for your models once they are live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and the day they start behaving differently.

  • Tell senior stakeholders things they do not want to hear, including that a campaign, a feature or a rule did not work.

  • Support your teammates in growing every day by setting the standard for how we do causal inference, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge.

What We Look For

  • Strong applied experience turning a messy business question into a model or a measurement: causal inference where that fits, predictive and ranking models where it does not. You know when a result is not real.

  • Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working independently rather than waiting for data to be handed to you. We use Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Looker, on top of technologies like MySQL, Druid, Kafka and Flink.

  • A track record of models that made it into production and changed a decision, not just notebooks and slide decks.

  • Sound statistical judgement, and the honesty to quantify and communicate uncertainty rather than hide it.

  • Exceptional communication skills. We expect you to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively.

  • Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering people with freedom and accountability.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building with agentic tooling such as MCP or agent frameworks, or automation platforms like n8n.

As our PostgreSQL DBA, you will be the go-to engineer for everything data-layer: index and schema design on multi-terabyte tables, query optimization for application teams, connection pooling, upgrades, and migrations. Our PostgreSQL runs on Amazon Aurora —  operating a large, fast-growing fleet consistently: turning one-off procedures into reliable automation, keeping dozens of clusters healthy at once, and helping developers use the database well.   • Production experience with managed PostgreSQL (Aurora or RDS) and a clear-eyed view of its constraints.

  • Working proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices; comfortable in Linux.

  • Experience with connection pooling (PgBouncer or similar) in production.

  • Comfort using AI coding assistants to accelerate routine analysis and tooling.

Tech Stack

En étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Creative Insights, cette personne sera chargée de l’identification, de la sélection et de la mise en valeur des contenus visuels de la bibliothèque Getty Images et iStock afin de promouvoir régulièrement l’étendue, la qualité, la créativité et la différenciation de l’offre visuelle Creative.


Who You Are:

You are passionate about the way imagery works. You are naturally interested in visual communication in all forms and love discussing the content that you come across. You are equal parts creative, analytical and commercial. You enjoy selecting and curating visuals to tell compelling stories that are commercially relevant and are comfortable sharing your visual expertise with the world at large. You are highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage the moving parts of multiple work streams operating simultaneously while still meeting deadlines. You are a creative problem-solver with the ability to quickly identify problems and work independently to find appropriate solutions. You have a pulse on what’s new and next in art and culture and are not afraid to share your insights and perspective with a multi-disciplinary creative team.

Votre profil:

Vous êtes passionné(e) par l’image et par la manière dont elle communique. Vous vous intéressez naturellement à toutes les formes de communication visuelle et aimez échanger autour des contenus que vous découvrez. Vous combinez sens créatif, esprit analytique et vision commerciale. Vous aimez sélectionner et mettre en scène des visuels pour raconter des histoires pertinentes sur le plan commercial et êtes à l’aise pour partager votre expertise visuelle. Vous êtes organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs projets simultanément tout en respectant les délais. Vous êtes force de proposition, autonome dans la résolution de problèmes et attentif(ve) aux nouvelles tendances de l’art et de la culture.


Your Next Challenge:
Insights-Driven Curation & Promotion
  • Provide promotional sets of visuals for assigned Creative Insights research projects, thought leadership (e.g., trend articles, toolkits, etc.), and other activities as assigned
  • Support bespoke requests for promotional sets of visuals to be funneled directly to key customers as part of partnership activations or as incentive for enterprise deals
  • Create themed sets of visuals to accompany insights for materials developed by Regional Marketing as well as PR activities such as press mentions, interviews, bylines, and events
  • Select and regularly rotate visuals to be promoted on the Getty Images and iStock homepages as well as on other owned social platforms such as Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn and email newsletters
  • Manage the merchandising of our key global and regional Creative special collections, curations and galleries (e.g., Project #ShowUs, The Disability Collection, LGBTQIA+ Curation, etc.) across Getty Images and iStock site pages
  • Support process for submission of premium visuals, stories, thought leadership) for awards and industry recognition
    • Visual Strategy & Education
  • Collaborate with Insights team to create visual narratives for key research and thought leadership projects in-region
  • Maintain regular visibility into Getty Images and iStock visual offering, working directly with Content Creation teams to monitor new content so that curations are kept both fresh and relevant
  • Work with Insights, Sales Research and Custom Solutions teams to identify customer needs and content gaps in our visual offering
  • Develop and lead regular updates and trainings on new visual narratives and strategy in tandem with Insights team
  • Brainstorm and provide ongoing POV on visual trends across things aesthetics, video, subject, industry, regional
  • Set and maintain regional strategies for the ongoing development of the Creative special collections and ensure alignment to global strategy.
    • Vos principales missions
  • Fournir des sélections promotionnelles de visuels pour les projets de recherche Creative Insights, les initiatives de leadership d’opinion (articles de tendances, guides, etc.) et toute autre activité confiée.
  • Soutenir les demandes spécifiques de sélections de visuels destinées aux clients stratégiques dans le cadre de partenariats ou d’opportunités commerciales.
  • Créer des ensembles thématiques de visuels pour accompagner les supports marketing régionaux ainsi que les activités RP.
  • Sélectionner et renouveler régulièrement les visuels mis en avant sur les sites Getty Images et iStock, ainsi que sur les réseaux sociaux et newsletters.
  • Gérer la mise en avant des principales collections créatives mondiales et régionales.
  • Contribuer aux candidatures et soumissions pour des prix et reconnaissances du secteur.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Insights pour développer des récits visuels autour des projets de recherche et de leadership d’opinion.
  • Assurer une veille régulière de l’offre visuelle Getty Images et iStock et travailler avec les équipes de création de contenu pour maintenir des sélections pertinentes et actualisées.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Insights, Sales Research et Custom Solutions afin d’identifier les besoins clients et les lacunes de l’offre visuelle.
  • Concevoir et animer des formations et mises à jour régulières sur les nouvelles orientations visuelles et stratégiques.
  • Apporter un point de vue sur les tendances visuelles en matière d’esthétique, vidéo, sujets, secteurs et régions.
  • Définir et piloter les stratégies régionales pour le développement des collections créatives spéciales, en cohérence avec la stratégie globale.

    • You should have:
  • At least 3+ years of experience in a related field (photography, filmmaking, visual arts, photo editing, art direction etc.)
  • High visual literacy with a broad understanding of photography as a medium, trends in popular culture (film, TV, music, art), global news, etc. Video/filmmaking knowledge is a plus, but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas visually to different audiences.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple distinct projects at the same time.
  • Positive, collaborative attitude with a passion for creative excellence.
  • Experience thriving in a fast-moving, dynamic creative environment while not losing sight of critical details.
  • Strong organizational, project and time management skills
  • Proficiency in relevant software applications, particularly Microsoft PowerPoint (and/or Keynote) and Excel.

    • Profil recherché:

  • 3+ ans d’expérience minimum dans un domaine connexe (photographie, cinéma, arts visuels, édition photo, direction artistique, etc.).
  • Excellente culture visuelle et bonne compréhension de la photographie, des tendances culturelles, médiatiques et artistiques.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication et aptitude à présenter des idées complexes de manière visuelle.
  • Capacité démontrée à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets distincts.
  • Esprit positif, collaboratif et passion pour l’excellence créative.
  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique tout en conservant une grande attention aux détails.
  • Excellentes compétences d’organisation, de gestion de projet et de gestion du temps.
  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques pertinents, notamment Microsoft PowerPoint (ou Keynote) et Excel.
  • Anglais professionnel requis
    • There’s a story in every picture, a narrative in every frame. We believe in the power of visuals. As a leading visual content creator, our three brands–Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash–offer a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of any customer, whatever their size, location, or budget. Whether the goal is commercial or philanthropic, revenue-generating or society-changing, market-disrupting or headline-driving, our visuals help any brand, business, or organization communicate more effectively with their target audience and urge them to action. In other words, we know how powerful an image or video can be—and that it can move the world. Working at Getty Images Our goal is to be one of the best places to work globally, which means we’re dedicated to providing experiences and resources that allow you to do your best work. Foundational to our culture are our Leadership Principles, which are the shared values that guide how we come together to do our work. We raise the bar and collectively bring solutions while exercising trust, transparency, and care. We actively reject biased behavior and are inclusive of different voices, perspectives, and experiences. We focus on our customers and deliver on our commitments and commercial goals. We foster a collaborative and supportive environment that prioritizes delivering results efficiently and using time wisely, so that all employees can achieve balance between commitments to the company and health and well-being in our lives. We value the importance of rest and recovery ranging from company-paid holidays to time away from work. Our employees’ growth, development, belonging, and engagement are important investments. We offer learning experiences ranging from leadership development, diversity and inclusion training, mentoring programs, a high potential program, and professional and skills development. We prioritize staying connected in our hybrid-working world and encourage participation in global morale events and local gatherings, as well as finding community in one or more of our Employee Resource Groups. Learning about our business is paramount, and our open and transparent culture means you’ll have direct access to experts and senior leaders via open forums, all hands, and content hours. Getty Images believes that diversity is critical to our success in moving the world and is committed to creating an inclusive, mutually respectful environment that celebrates diversity. We seek to hire based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. Getty Images is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Senior Investment Consultant Wohn- & Geschäftshäuser (m/w/d) Leipzig
descriptionHtml:
PLANETHOME INVESTMENTS


Senior Investment Consultant Wohn- & Geschäftshäuser (m/w/d)

Standort: Leipzig | Fokus: Neuaufbau PlanetHome Investments

Der Leipziger Investmentmarkt schläft nicht. Und wir auch nicht.

PlanetHome zählt seit Jahren zu den führenden Immobilienvermittlern Deutschlands. Mit unserem exklusiven Zugang zu namhaften Banken, Wealth-Management-Einheiten, Unternehmenskundenbereichen und Finanzdienstleistern verfügen wir über ein einzigartiges Netzwerk. Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten strategischen Schritt.

Für den Aufbau von PlanetHome Investments suchen wir keine Verwalter bestehender Strukturen. Wir suchen Unternehmer im Unternehmen: Macher, die einen Geschäftsbereich von Anfang an mitgestalten wollen. Die Marktchancen erkennen, bevor andere sie sehen, und wissen, dass große Abschlüsse Leidenschaft und Drive erfordern. Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen First Mover mit Hands-on-Mentalität.

WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET: ECHTER GESTALTUNGSSPIELRAUM

Du steigst nicht in einen starren Konzernapparat ein, sondern wirst Teil des Kernteams, das PlanetHome Investments aufbaut. Deine Ideen, Dein Marktverständnis und Deine Erfahrung sind ausdrücklich gewünscht und prägen unsere gemeinsame Zukunft.

Deine Vorteile – Eine starke Plattform im Rücken:

· Etablierte Marke: Vertrauen und Schlagkraft eines führenden Immobilienunternehmens.

· Exklusiver Partnerzugang: Direkter Zugang zu einem deutschlandweiten Banknetzwerk (Private Banking, Wealth Management, Corporate Banking).

· Startvorteil: Zugriff auf bestehende Investmentmandate und kontinuierlichen Lead-Zufluss.

· Agilität: Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem hochmotivierten Team, das wachsen will und wird.

· Kundenvielfalt: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit privaten Investoren, Semi-Professionals, Family Offices und institutionellen Marktteilnehmern.

DEINE AUFGABEN

· Akquisition & Betreuung: Verantwortung für hochwertige Verkaufsmandate im Investmentsegment.

· Netzwerkaufbau: Nachhaltige Verankerung und Expansion des Netzwerks zu Eigentümern, Investoren und Marktteilnehmern im Raum Leipzig.

· Transaktionsmanagement: Strukturierung und Steuerung von Off-Market- und On-Market-Transaktionen von der Akquise bis zum

Notartermin.

· Bewertung & Positionierung: Professionelle Einwertung und marktgerechte Positionierung von Investmentimmobilien.

· Bereichsaufbau: Aktive Mitgestaltung der Prozesse, Strategien und Standards für PlanetHome Investments.

WAS DU MITBRINGEN SOLLTEST

· Track Record: Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Investmentgeschäft oder in der Vermittlung von Wohn- und Geschäftshäusern.

· Marktnetzwerk: Belastbarer Zugang zu Eigentümern, Investoren, Projektentwicklern oder Family Offices.

· Vertriebsstärke & Verhandlungsgeschick: Hohe Eigenmotivation, Abschlussstärke und Freude an der Akquise.

· Unternehmer-Mindset: Lust auf Gestaltungsspielraum – wenn ein Prozess noch nicht im Handbuch steht, erkennst Du die Chance, Dinge besser zu machen.

WAS DU VON UNS ERWARTEN KANNST

· Leistung soll sich lohnen: Wer außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielt, soll auch außergewöhnlich verdienen. Wir bieten ein Vergütungsmodell, das unternehmerisches Denken und Erfolg unmittelbar belohnt.

· Home & Office: Wir glauben an Marktpräsenz, Teamgeist und Geschwindigkeit. Der persönliche Austausch im Büro ist für uns ein echter Erfolgsfaktor, ergänzt durch moderne, flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten.

· Für Menschen, die das Geschäft lieben: Work-Life-Balance ist wichtig. Aber diese Position richtet sich an Professionals, die Immobilien, Investments und Transaktionen nicht nur als Job betrachten, sondern als Leidenschaft. Wenn Du morgens aufwachst und Dich fragst, welche Opportunität heute im Markt entsteht, dann könntest Du hervorragend zu uns passen.

KLINGT NACH DIR?
Dann lass uns sprechen! Egal ob Du aktuell Wohn- und Geschäftshäuser vermittelst, im Investmentbereich eines Maklerhauses tätig bist oder für eine Boutique, ein Family Office, eine Bank oder Beratungsgesellschaft arbeitest: Wenn Du beim Aufbau von PlanetHome Investments in Leipzig eine Schlüsselrolle übernehmen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior / Lead Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Nebius is looking for a Senior / Lead Program Manager to help develop and execute our asset-light model for expanding AI infrastructure through partnerships.

You will work at the intersection of strategy, finance, commercial negotiations and execution. Your focus will be to turn complex partnership opportunities into clear business cases, workable commercial terms and agreements that support the needs of Nebius, our partners and our customers.

This role suits someone who combines structured problem-solving with strong financial understanding and the ability to move work forward across multiple teams. You should be comfortable assessing commercial trade-offs, bringing clarity to ambiguous problems and taking responsibility for progress.

This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional responsibility. You will lead projects and influence stakeholders without direct line-management responsibility.

What you’ll do

  • Develop commercial frameworks and term sheets. Define proposed terms for asset-light partnerships, balancing financial returns, risk, responsibilities and the interests of Nebius and its partners.
  • Support the partnership team. Build the operational framework, track and report progress, develop commercial guidelines
  • Build business cases with Finance. Coordinate the analysis supporting partnership proposals, working through financial models, testing assumptions and assessing how different commercial terms affect the economics.
  • Shape contractual and legal structures. Partner with Legal and relevant business teams to translate the commercial model into practical structures and agreements for partners and customers.
  • Drive cross-functional execution. Bring together Finance, Legal, commercial, technical and operational stakeholders, establishing clear ownership, resolving dependencies and maintaining momentum.
  • Prepare decisions and recommendations. Turn complex information into clear options, explain trade-offs and help stakeholders reach informed decisions.
  • Develop repeatable ways of working. Capture lessons from individual partnerships and improve the frameworks, templates and processes that support the model as it grows.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in management consulting or a strategy and operations role within a technology business.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down unfamiliar, complex problems and develop practical recommendations.
  • Financial fluency: you can read and work with financial models, challenge assumptions and explain the commercial implications of the numbers. A specialist financial analyst background is not required.
  • Experience developing business cases, assessing commercial opportunities or supporting complex transactions and partnerships.
  • Confidence working with commercial terms and contracts alongside finance and legal specialists.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to align teams with different priorities and influence without formal authority.
  • The initiative and judgment to drive projects independently, manage ambiguity and recognise when a decision needs wider input.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, particularly when presenting analysis and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Revenue operations background: Supporting sales or partnership teams with clear processes, compensation structure etc.

Experience that would be valuable

  • Work on large, complex projects in data centres, digital infrastructure, real estate, power or related sectors.
  • Revenue operations background: supporting sales or partnership teams with clear processes, compensation structure etc.
  • Exposure to partnership models, infrastructure economics or arrangements involving several commercial counterparties.
  • Experience taking a strategic recommendation through negotiation and into implementation.
  • Sector experience is valuable, but we are also interested in strong generalists who can learn a new business model quickly and apply sound commercial judgment.



Why join Nebius

Nebius is scaling a new generation of AI infrastructure across EMEA. You will have genuine ownership of how that infrastructure is designed, standardised and delivered, working on complex projects where technical judgement has a direct impact on speed, capacity and long-term operational performance.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Career growth and continuous learning
  • Flexibility, trust and real ownership
  • An international environment with highly experienced technical teams
  • The opportunity to shape infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI

Equal opportunity

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate on any characteristic protected by applicable law. Please tell us if you need an accommodation during the application process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment.
