title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer - DFM
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do
  • You’ll be the focal point between product development (Engineering) and industrialization (Manufacturing)
  • Ensure manufacturing optimized design decisions from early project phases. Advise and consult the engineering team based on your expertise in manufacturing.
  • Represent manufacturing in concept development, design meetings and design reviews. Flagging risks and proactively developing solutions and suggestions for improvements.
  • Follow the entire manufacturing engineering process until full production rate to capture lessons learned and best practices from each program to implement into following design projects.
  • Develop tools and processes to ensure an effective and efficient DFM process, supportive to Engineering teams and overall accelerating the time to market and efficiency.
  • Suggest technologies and processes to be considered. Initiate strategic competence build-up if beneficial and required to a program.
  • Work with vendors and equipment manufacturers to identify innovative solutions to manufacturing problems. Drive co-development for highly specialized processes & technologies.
  • Operate as a manufacturing all‑rounder, bridging detailed process design with factory‑level thinking to ensure coherent design and seamless integration into the manufacturing system at exceptional industrialization speed.
  • Identify process‑level risks and trade‑offs early, driving mitigations through design, analysis, or process changes.
  • Produce and maintain clear documentation, including drawings, specifications, and design justifications.
  • Act as a technically credible problem‑solver in ambiguous environments, closing decisions and keeping programs moving at pace.

Who you are
  • A senior Manufacturing Engineer with firsthand expertise and experience in manufacturing / assembly. Ideally combined with experience in product design or previous DFM roles.
  • Experienced working on complex, integrated manufacturing systems. Ideally in aerospace, defence, or other high‑performance, cross functional environments under intense time pressure.
  • Managing partners and suppliers proficiently and effectively. Motivating everyone to go above and beyond to achieve common goals and timelines.
  • Dealing well with ambiguity and uncertainty, willing to anticipate, test and reconsider if necessary.
  • Comfortable operating at multiple levels of abstraction from detailed design to work center‑ or system‑level.
  • Experienced working on complex, integrated systems, ideally in aerospace, defence, or other high‑performance hardware environments.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals covering process- and product design
  • Pragmatic and delivery‑focused, able to make sound engineering trade‑offs without over‑engineering
  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and acting as a technical integrator, not just a specialist.
  • Hands‑on by instinct, willing to support build, integration, and test when needed.
  • Calm and effective in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where priorities evolve.
  • Motivated by building real, high‑consequence hardware where mechanical and system correctness truly matter.

What we offer
  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

Security and Eligibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV) At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

A real say in profitability. Margin is owned jointly by the pod through different lenses. When you cut parcel losses or make a collection run more efficiently, you’ll see exactly what it’s worth, and so will everyone else.

A career you can shape. Our Account Management team is tripling. Go deeper, taking on bigger and more complex accounts until you’re the expert the business leans on. Or go wider, across more pods, and in time lead others doing what you do.

About G2 - The Company

G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.

Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.

And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.

Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!

About G2 - Our People

At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (Performance + Entrepreneurship + Authenticity + Kindness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.

You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.

About The Role

As G2’s only Partner Manager based in EMEA, your mission is to expand the impact of G2’s most strategic partners to EMEA, building real influence with the EMEA based revenue and marketing leaders and their orgs at G2’s strategic integration, agency and channel partners. You'll drive inbound co-sell activity to our field and collaborate with G2’s revenue org to effectively activate partners in their deal and renewal cycles. You will also extend this internal work to G2’s field in APAC

As part of this role, you’ll work to grow EMEA based relationships and revenue with newly established Ads partners, a growing revenue segment at G2, and a select set of agency partners you will prioritize as having the highest leverage for pipeline generation and revenue in the region. Core to this role is the ability to work globally with the North American based team to understand and extend the global strategy for the partners you’re activating in EMEA, while also partnering very closely with EMEA based revenue leaders.

In This Role, You Will: 

Build and Expand Partner Relationships to Grow Influence Across G2

  • Develop genuine influence with EMEA-based revenue and marketing leaders at partner organizations, establishing yourself as the regional counterpart for partners whose primary relationship with G2 has historically been run from North America.

  • Work closely with the North American partner team to understand and extend the global strategy for each partner you activate, while providing regional insight that shapes how those strategies land in EMEA & APAC.

  • Partner with G2’s EMEA revenue leaders and field teams to activate partners in live deals and renewal cycles, ensuring partner involvement is timely, relevant, and tied to specific accounts and opportunities.

  • Work with partner-side Sales, Marketing, and Enablement teams in the region to launch joint offers, map shared accounts, and deliver customer-facing education on our joint value, adapting messaging to local market dynamics, languages, and buying behaviors.

  • Partner with CS leadership in region to drive adoption of integrations among EMEA & APAC customers to increase renewal and expansion, and extend partner use cases (e.g., MCP Connectors, data package installations) across G2’s most strategic integration partners in the region.

  • Monitor and analyze EMEA partner performance to optimize program impact, and provide regular updates to leadership on adoption rates, pipeline contribution, and revenue impact by region and partner.

Partner Development

  • Develop a select set of new partner relationships that have high leverage for EMEA & APAC pipeline and revenue. Manage development end-to-end, from initial conversations through commercials, GTM planning, and activation.

  • Embed G2 within partner revenue teams, building the relationships and cadence needed to keep G2 top of mind as a growth lever for them.

  • Ensure G2's internal teams understand the value each partner brings and how to activate them to drive revenue for their own books of business.

Be a Subject Matter Expert on G2’s integration capabilities

  • Build rapport with sales and partners as an expert on G2 and our partner ecosystem

  • Create leverage on the Partnership team by consistently sharing new learnings and industry insights

Minimum Qualifications:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

  • 7+ years of experience in tech-related partnerships, sales, or customer success, with a track record of developing senior and executive-level relationships across partner revenue, marketing, and product organizations

  • Ability to understand and effectively communicate the basic mechanics and shared value of G2’s integrations with our most strategic partners.

  • Proven experience developing and scaling partnerships globally, with a track record of consistently delivering strong adoption and revenue growth

  • Strong prospecting and relationship-building skills

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, bringing innovation and good judgment to fast-paced, quickly changing environments, and knowing when to bring structure and process as we grow and adapt to a shifting market

  • Exceptional relationship management, collaboration, and communication skills

  • A self-starter who exhibits passion, persistence, and drive in your work. 

What Can Help Your Application Stand Out:

  • Experience working in adtech, some knowledge and comfort level navigating conversations with publishers and DSPs 

About the Office

London is home to our EMEA headquarters. The London office has a strong in-office culture and meet frequently in person to collaborate and win together. Because of this, we prefer candidates who are interested in going into the office 2-3 days a week.

Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity

At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status. Learn more about our commitments here.

title: Senior People Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Senior People Business Partner

As a Senior People Business Partner at myTomorrows, you are a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the Leadership Team. This is our most senior individual contributor People Business Partner role, where you translate business priorities into practical people solutions that enable high performing teams and organizational growth.

You partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands on execution and are comfortable navigating the pace, ambiguity, and opportunities of a fast growing international scale up.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates who live within commuting distance of our Amsterdam office.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Partner with senior leaders and Leadership Team members on organizational design, workforce planning, team effectiveness, and organizational health.

  • Coach leaders on performance management, leadership effectiveness, feedback, development, and difficult people conversations.

  • Lead complex employee relations cases, including performance improvement, conflict resolution, absence management, and sensitive exits.

  • Drive and continuously improve key People programs, including performance management, engagement, talent reviews, succession planning, and career development.

  • Translate business strategy into practical People initiatives that support organizational growth and scalability.

  • Use people data and insights to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and recommend actions that improve engagement, retention, and organizational performance.

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and People Operations to deliver an outstanding employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle.

  • Ensure consistent application of People policies, employment legislation, and People practices across your business areas.

  • Lead cross functional People projects that improve organizational effectiveness, manager capability, and operational excellence.

  • Act as a trusted sparring partner who balances strategic thinking with hands on execution.

What you bring to the table:

  • At least 6 years of experience as an HR Business Partner or People Business Partner in a fast growing international organization.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organizational and people topics.

  • Extensive experience managing complex employee relations, performance management, and organizational change.

  • Strong coaching, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch employment law and HR best practices.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate people data into actionable business insights.

  • Comfortable operating independently, making sound judgments, and managing competing priorities.

  • Experience working in a technology, SaaS, HealthTech, or scale up environment is highly preferred.

  • Experience with modern HR systems such as Personio is a plus.

  • Experience supporting international teams is a plus.

What we offer:

  • Serve a purposeful mission by helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments.

  • International work environment with scale up energy and a flat organization.

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity.

  • Great career development opportunities in a growing company.

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions.

  • Attractive pension plan with the full premium covered by us.

  • Hybrid working model.

  • Policies that support working parents.

  • Healthy lunch at the office.

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists through OpenUp.

  • An additional holiday every year to celebrate Liberation Day on May 5.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

As a Senior People Systems & Analytics Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping, developing and optimising our HR systems landscape. Working closely with Talent, Finance, IT and business stakeholders, you will help ensure our people systems provide reliable data, efficient processes and a seamless employee experience while supporting organisational growth.

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

title: Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph | Germany | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph

This is a remote position based in Germany. 

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success.

As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best.

Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences.

You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user
  • Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity
  • Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives
  • Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team
  • Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations 
  • Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements
  • Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users
  • A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them
  • Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind
  • Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space
  • Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity
  • Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain
  • Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring
  • Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact

When you apply, please:

  • Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 88,240 - EUR 105,888. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

title: Senior Product Designer, London, UK
descriptionHtml:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

You're a talented Senior Product Designer with a passion for health and excitement about building our expanding healthcare platform. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, solving complex problems, and creating thoughtful, user-centred design solutions that make a real impact.

In this role, you will:

  • Own a problem area across connected surfaces, not a queue of screens, from definition to delivery.
  • Research it, design it, write it, test it, measure it, iterate. You drive it without waiting for a spec.
  • Move commercial outcomes on your surface: activation, conversion through regulated intake, retention, adherence. You know which metric you are moving and why.
  • Create designs that build trust and hold up in a regulated market.

What good looks like

  • Scope: you own a problem area end to end.
  • Impact: you moved a meaningful metric and can show the before and after.
  • Influence: you raise the bar around you. You give sharp critique. You make junior designers better without being asked to.

About you (who you are)

You're a talented Senior Product Designer with a passion for health and excitement about building our expanding healthcare platform. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, solving complex problems, and creating thoughtful, user-centred design solutions that make a real impact.

Skills & experience

  • Problem definition. You shape the problem, not just the pixels. Using research, data and the input of others, you break the ambiguity down and package it back up into something the team can build. The signal is evidence you helped define the right problem, not just made the screens.
  • Visual craft. Non-negotiable. Typography, spacing, colour, motion and micro-interactions, used with intent, not decoration. Weak craft is a no, whatever the strategy talk.
  • Accessibility. You design inclusively without being asked. You know why the standard exists, not just what it says, and it shows in judgement calls a checklist cannot make.
  • Systems thinking. You design across surfaces, from mobile to emerging platforms like AI-native interfaces, and contribute to the system others build on. Infrastructure compounds. Single screens do not.
  • Product and commercial sense. You shaped what got built. Metrics, research and commercial awareness sit next to the work. Craft in isolation moves nothing.
  • Communication. Clear, specific, opinionated. You say what you decided and why, and you are just as clear on what you chose not to do and why.
  • Working in the open. You share early and often, and you use critique to sharpen the work. You lift the quality of every review you join.
How you work with AI
  • LLMs are already embedded in your workflow.
  • You prototype in tools like Claude Code and Cursor to test ideas in real code, not just mock them up. Tighter build-measure-learn loops.
  • The signal is workflow, not tool count. Judgement spent where it counts.
The full stack

We expect you to work end to end, from problem definition and research to information architecture and UX writing.

  • Your own research and usability testing.
  • Validation and experimentation. You set up A/B tests and read them honestly.
  • UX writing. In a regulated market, this is craft and compliance at once.
  • Problem definition. Break it down. Package it back up.
Your portfolio

Show problem solving that moved a commercial lever, not just well-made screens. We want evidence of the outcome, the craft behind it, the care in the finish, how you contributed to the Design System, and where AI tightened your process. How you write it says as much as what you show. Concise and clear is a signal of how you communicate. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Experience

Typically 5 to 8 years in product design, with a track record of owning problems end to end and influencing direction at a team level.

Behaviours & attitude

  • Patient-first mindset. You put patient outcomes first. Every decision weighs commercial growth against clinical safety and care, and you don't let one erode the other. You understand real health journeys well enough to make them simple, accessible and worth trusting.
  • Collaborative creation. You work well across product, engineering and clinical, and you know a good idea can come from any of them. You listen to feedback and take it on, using it to make the work better.
  • Curiosity. You ask why before how. You stay curious about the patient, the problem and the tools you use to solve it, and you're comfortable being a beginner when something new is worth learning.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

  • What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
  • Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
  • Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
  • Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
  • Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in the UK

  • Be an owner – Your own stake in the business with our employee options program

As a Senior Quality Engineer at Freetrade, you will be embedded in our mobile team, testing our iOS and Android apps and helping us move from largely manual testing towards a more automated approach. About You

  • Hands-on experience testing iOS and Android apps, and adding tests to an existing automation framework (we use TypeScript; familiarity helps and tool agnosticism is welcome)

  • A blend of manual and automated testing, with breadth across testing types (functional, acceptance and exploratory, with non-functional a bonus) and the judgement to know which to use when

  • You’ve owned testing and built things, such as a framework, automation or a test process your team adopted

  • Strong written and verbal communication (fluent English) and influencing skills, comfortable sharing test plans and reports and advising engineers, product owners and project managers

title: Senior Recruiter – Active Sourcing & Recruiting-Marketing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst Menschen gewinnen. Und an Ergebnissen gemessen werden.

Für uns hat Recruiting dieselbe Energie wie guter Vertrieb: Chancen erkennen, eine überzeugende Ansprache entwickeln, viel umsetzen und konsequent am Ball bleiben.

Du planst und drehst Recruiting-Ads und Content. Du knüpfst Kontakte, entwickelst dein Netzwerk und gehst im Active Sourcing auf interessante Menschen zu. Du testest neue Ansätze, führst Gespräche und hältst die nächsten Schritte verbindlich nach.

Was dich antreibt: Verantwortung, eine hohe eigene Schlagzahl und sichtbare Ergebnisse. Klare Ziele geben dir Orientierung. Leistungsabhängige Vergütung motiviert dich. Du willst selbst beeinflussen, was du erreichst.

So gewinnst du die richtigen Menschen für unser Team

Bei Rügamer & Steiner rekrutierst du für unser eigenes Unternehmen – von Sales über Projekt- und Accountmanagement bis zu Content und AI/Tech. Dafür verbindest du mehrere Wege:

  • Recruiting-Ads: Du entwickelst Botschaften und Videoideen für unsere Stellen und planst die Aufnahmen gemeinsam mit uns. Vor der Kamera stehen unter anderem Aurelian, Simeon und Noah – gelegentlich auch du selbst.

  • Content: Du planst und drehst Inhalte, die unsere Arbeit, unser Team und die beruflichen Möglichkeiten bei uns sichtbar machen.

  • Netzwerk: Du baust aktiv Beziehungen auf, erschließt Empfehlungen und bringst interessante Menschen zusammen. Zum Beispiel organisierst du ein monatliches Abendessen mit Account-Managern aus Düsseldorf: zum Kennenlernen, für fachlichen Austausch und um langfristig Kontakte zu Menschen aufzubauen, die unser Team verstärken könnten.

  • Active Sourcing: Du findest passende Kandidaten und sprichst sie persönlich an – über LinkedIn, Nachrichten und Telefon.

  • Gespräche und Nachhalten: Du klärst Erfahrung, Motivation und Erwartungen, hältst Kontakt und bringst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads der einzelnen Abteilungen die nächsten Schritte bis zur Entscheidung voran.

Du schaust dir an, welche Ansprache funktioniert, welche Inhalte Interesse wecken und über welche Wege passende Menschen kommen. Daraus entwickelst du die nächsten Maßnahmen. Du verantwortest, dass aus deinen Aktivitäten gute Gespräche und erfolgreiche Besetzungen entstehen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast bereits Menschen gewonnen und Stellen besetzt – in einer Personalberatung, im Inhouse-Recruiting oder für dein eigenes Unternehmen.

Oder du kommst aus Vertrieb oder Marketing und willst deine Erfahrung jetzt im Recruiting einsetzen. Du weißt, wie man Zielgruppen versteht, Interesse weckt, überzeugende Gespräche führt und aus ersten Kontakten konkrete Ergebnisse entwickelt.

Entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen gewinnen kannst, eigenständig ins Handeln kommst und bereit bist, dir das Recruiting-Handwerk anzueignen. Zeig uns anhand konkreter Beispiele, was du selbst vorangebracht und erreicht hast.

Du kommunizierst überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, organisierst mehrere Suchen gleichzeitig und hältst Zusagen zuverlässig nach. Du hast Lust, sichtbar zu werden, Ideen auszuprobieren und dich an Ergebnissen messen zu lassen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und den Verantwortlichen unserer Fachbereiche zusammen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, mit welchen Menschen wir unser Unternehmen weiter aufbauen.

Du gestaltest unsere Ansprache mit, entwickelst neue Wege der Kandidatengewinnung und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung. Klassische HR-Verwaltung gehört nicht zu deiner Rolle. Bei Kampagnentechnik und Videoschnitt arbeitest du mit den jeweils Zuständigen zusammen.

Dein Arbeitsort ist unser Büro in Düsseldorf. Wir bieten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 26 Urlaubstagen.

Leistung soll sich für dich lohnen

Unser Ziel ist, dass du bei uns 100.000 € und mehr im Jahr verdienen kannst. Für die Position sehen wir eine Gesamtvergütung von 6.000–12.000 € brutto im Monat inklusive variablem Anteil vor. Wir suchen jemanden, den klare Ziele, Verantwortung und leistungsabhängige Vergütung motivieren – und der seinen Erfolg selbst mitgestalten will.

Zeig uns, wie du Menschen gewinnst

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein konkretes Beispiel: Wie hast du passende Menschen erreicht, ihr Interesse geweckt und daraus ein Ergebnis entwickelt? Das kann eine Besetzung sein oder – bei deinem Quereinstieg – ein passendes Beispiel aus Vertrieb oder Marketing. Ein Satz dazu reicht für den ersten Schritt. Alles Weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam im Call. Bitte ohne vertrauliche Personen- oder Kundendaten.

title: Senior Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Senior Recruiter

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £90k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

We plan to grow the team substantially over the next year, and our hiring bar will shape what Deducta becomes. This role owns searches end to end across our most important hires, so we can build an exceptional team without depending on external agencies. You'll report to the Chief of Staff.

This isn't a recruiting coordination role. You'll recruit across product, engineering, customer, GTM and operations, build pipelines from scratch, and shape how Deducta hires, from interview design to employer brand.

What you'll do

  • End-to-end searches: Own searches from role definition and sourcing strategy through assessment, closing, references and offer.

  • Proactive sourcing: Find and engage exceptional candidates directly, rather than relying on inbound applications or external agencies.

  • Hiring manager partnership: Work with leadership and hiring managers to define what great looks like and turn it into a focused search.

  • Assessment and closing: Assess candidates' capabilities, motivations and trajectory with strong judgement, and help us win the people we want.

  • Candidate experience: Keep every process fast and well communicated, with a high bar for every interaction.

  • Recruiting systems: Build and improve interview design, scorecards, pipeline reporting and our use of Ashby, and help build our talent network and employer brand.

Success in this role means:

  • Strong pipelines: Our highest-priority roles have strong pipelines of exceptional candidates, and we hire without depending on external recruiters.

  • Clear visibility: Leadership has a clear view of pipeline health, trade-offs and next steps.

  • Great candidate experience: Candidates move through the process quickly and consistently have an excellent experience.

  • Scalable process: Our recruiting processes become more rigorous and scalable as the company grows.

Who you are

We're looking for an experienced recruiter who combines excellent sourcing with strong judgement and high ownership, and who is comfortable working as a hands-on individual contributor. Experience at high-growth technology companies is strongly preferred, but a background in our industry isn't required.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of top-tier recruiting: You've owned challenging searches from kickoff through close in competitive markets.

  • Exceptional sourcing: You know how to find and engage candidates who aren't actively applying.

  • Candidate judgement: You get beyond a CV to assess capability, trajectory, motivation and fit.

  • Commercial instinct: You know recruiting is partly about identifying talent and partly about winning it.

  • Clear communication: You build credibility with candidates and hiring managers and keep everyone informed throughout a process.

  • Operational discipline: You keep pipelines organised, follow through relentlessly and use data to see where a search is working or breaking down.

  • Nice to have: Experience recruiting across product, engineering, customer or commercial roles at an early-stage technology company.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical exercise

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.

Compensation: £90K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Sales Engineer, France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’d be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.  

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (Paris) or fully remote in France. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

In this role, you will: 

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.

title: (Senior) Software Engineer – AI (m/f/d) – Remote
descriptionHtml:
What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As a Software Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems.

What you can work on:

  • From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data.

  • Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results.

  • Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights.

  • Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents.

  • Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus.

  • Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them.

  • Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Apply with your CV here and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure / Efficiency / Productivity
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the Role

You will be a SME and technical leader in engineering Infrastructure, productivity and enterprise tooling, partnering with globally distributed Engineering, Product and Security teams and systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

Roku is seeking a world class engineer to be a true force multiplier by owning the strategy, architecture, and long-term execution of engineering infrastructure, enterprise tooling, and AI-assisted workflow automation. This architect/strategist role drives org-wide improvements in engineering productivity, delivery throughput, quality, security posture, and cost efficiency by building platforms, working practices and automation (including AI/LLM-enabled capabilities) that scale across geographies and time zones.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

Key Responsibilities

AI-First Automation & Intelligent Tooling

  • Define and lead an AI-first automation roadmap for Engineering Infrastructure and Enterprise Tooling (e.g., reducing waste, accelerating reviews, improving incident response, increasing release confidence).
  • Architect and ship AI/LLM-enabled workflow automation across the SDLC (e.g. risk assessment, automated build, test and deployment, intelligent test selection, change-impact analysis, auto-triage of build/test failures).
  • Establish policies and guardrails for AI usage in internal tools: data handling, prompt/response logging, model/provider selection, evaluation, fallback behaviors, and abuse prevention.

Dev Productivity & Enterprise Tooling (Global Scale)

  • Set technical direction and standards for the globally used developer tools, including build systems. Source code management, branching/release strategy, and self-service support tools.
  • Architect and evolve, CI/CD and build/test pipelines using Jenkins, Docker, and build systems (Bazel /BitBake/Yocto  preferred) to support multi-site engineering environments.
  • Own and scale test and quality workflows leveraging test management systems (e.g., TestRail or equivalent), enabling consistent traceability, reporting, and release sign-off across distributed teams.
  • Drive Jira workflow design and automation (templates, guardrails, integrations) to provide consistent cross-org visibility and execution.

Workflow Automation (Cross-Functional, Cross-Geo)

  • Design and implement automation spanning Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Partners (e.g., launch readiness, certification/release checklists, partner onboarding, incident/change workflows).
  • Replace manual coordination with durable automation and integrations that work reliably across regions/time zones.

Security, Cost, Performance, and Reliability (Distributed Systems)

  • Embed secure-by-default controls into pipelines and tooling (access control, secrets handling, audit trails, policy enforcement), including for AI-enabled systems.
  • Improve build/test performance and reliability (build times, test duration, flake reduction, pipeline stability) using measurable KPIs and operational rigor.
  • Drive cost efficiencies across tooling/infrastructure (compute utilization, caching strategies, license rationalization including AI/runtime costs and ROI tracking.
  • This is a highly visible role and you will report directly to a Vice President of Engineering. This requires a very strong technical leader with experience in the development of consumer electronics devices. The right person for this role will have ability to collaborate well with engineering and partner teams.
  • Own cross-team architectures and standards; drive adoption through influence, clear technical judgment, and sustained multi-quarter execution.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and unblock the hardest technical problems across distributed teams and systems.
  • Provide long-term stewardship via roadmaps, operational maturity (runbooks/SLOs), and incident/postmortem practices suitable for 24/7 global operations.
  • Establish yourself as the person others bring their hardest problems to

We’re Excited If You Have

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Prior experience at Staff, Principal, or Architect level
  • Ownership in platform/infrastructure, developer productivity, CI/CD, build systems, or workflow automation, including work spanning globally distributed teams and systems.
  • Strong, hands-on knowledge of:
    • Git (workflows, branching strategies, release management)
    • Jenkins (CI/CD pipeline design, scaling, reliability)
    • Docker containers (reproducible build/test execution)

Build systems ( itBake/Yocto preferred)

    • Jira (workflow design/automation, cross-team visibility)
    • Test management systems (e.g., TestRail or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated experience delivering automation at scale, including building platforms/components used by multiple teams.
  • Strong systems thinking across security, reliability, performance, and cost tradeoffs.
  • Excellent written communication (architecture docs, decision records, operating procedures).
  • Experience building AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g., CI insights, test intelligence, code review automation, release risk scoring, incident copilots).
  • Experience implementing evaluation/monitoring for AI systems (quality metrics, drift, offline test sets, human feedback loops).
  • Extensive experience with software development on embedded Linux,  multi-process architectures and IPC mechanisms
  • Experience working in large cross functional teams and ability to influence teams that don't report to you
  • Ability to see the big picture while focused on short-term objectives and deliverables
  • Ability to multi-task and drive parallel projects and distributed teams with tight deadlines
#LI-NM1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Anaplan is the leading enterprise decision-making platform, powering the world’s largest enterprises with our proprietary Hyperblock™ technology and cloud infrastructure. We are seeking an Engineer IV to join our team in Manchester, UK, or York, UK. 

Your Impact

  • Build and scale high-throughput backend engines that manage core request orchestration, seamless multi-tenant isolation, and API-first solutions serving thousands of tenants and tens of thousands of users.

  • Deliver thought leadership and coding excellence across Java/Kotlin, ensuring seamless integration between backend microservices and UI components (including resolving complex CORS and distributed edge proxy requirements).

  • Exceptional technical communicator with a proven ability to align globally distributed teams. You are highly skilled at distilling complex concepts into clear, structured RFCs and architectural designs to build consensus.
  • Understand, leverage, and integrate modern AI tools and concepts—including agentic programming patterns and LLM-assisted workflows—to accelerate platform engineering and developer velocity.

Preferred Skills

  • You have shaped architecture and platform strategy at an enterprise scale, navigating the trade-offs of hybrid and cloud-agnostic infrastructures.
  • You bring a polyglot mindset, matching the right technology to the challenge rather than defaulting to a single stack (comfortable exploring React, Python, or Go when needed).
  • Genuine curiosity—you're energized by learning new technologies and approaches to solve edge routing and platform enablement challenges.
