title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Staff Engineer - Fintech
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You will own the agents, skills and standards that let a tribe of product builders move quickly on payments without the architecture fragmenting. Hotels take payments across regions and through providers that each behave differently, and Payment Interfaces exists to give customers one coherent payment experience on top of several PSPs. Embedded payments at this depth is rare among European SaaS companies, so the problems here are ones few engineers get to work on.

You will be a Staff Engineer in the Payment Interfaces team, part of the Fintech tribe. You will report to the Director of Product and Engineering, sit in the tribe’s leadership group, and work alongside product builders, other staff engineers and product managers. No one reports to you, so your influence comes from the architecture, tools and standards that other people choose to work in.

The team integrates several PSPs depending on region and conditions. When integrations drift apart, builders slow down and quality suffers. This role exists to keep them coherent by encoding what good looks like into tools and agents, so every builder meets the standard by default.

What you would do 

  • Own the tribe’s engineering agents, skills and context, and encode architectural standards, review logic and quality gates into them so the standard is met by default.
  • Build an AI first responder for customer tickets about payment issues, with clear rules for when it answers and when it hands over to a person.
  • Stay hands-on for the hardest technical problems: migrations, system-wide refactors and long-lived architecture decisions across PSP integrations.
  • Keep Payment Interfaces integrations coherent as PSPs and regional requirements change, collaborating with builders who own their own work.
  • Coach builders and fix off-standard outcomes at the cause, so the lesson sticks.

AI Fluency Level 4: in this role, that means you build the AI systems the tribe works in, not only use them. You design the agents, skills and evaluations that builders rely on every day, make the engineering decisions about how they behave, and set the rules for when an AI answer can stand and when a person must step in.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to “AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates” on Confluence.

What you would bring 

  • Hands-on experience integrating with payment service providers or payment processors.
  • Deep engineering craft and architectural judgment, including a sense of what is worth codifying and what is a one-off.
  • AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you have built agents, skills, evaluations or tooling that other engineers use, and you can explain where human oversight stays non-negotiable.
  • A systems mindset that turns hard-won knowledge into reusable architecture and tooling rather than documentation.
  • Comfort with influence as your main way of getting things done, working with builders, product managers, principals and senior leaders without anyone reporting to you.

Nice to have 

  • Experience in hospitality, travel or another operationally complex B2B SaaS environment.
  • Experience publishing or speaking externally about your work.
  • A track record of coaching other engineers and multiplying their effectiveness.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion.

title: Stage duurzame en innovatieve materiaaloplossingen voor betonconstructies
descriptionHtml:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stage lopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Hoe maak je een betonconstructie duurzamer, zonder in te leveren op veiligheid en kwaliteit? Tijdens deze stage bij Dura Vermeer Divisie Infra onderzoek jij welke materialen daaraan kunnen bijdragen. Je combineert constructieve berekeningen met duurzaamheid en ontdekt hoe we materiaalkeuzes maken voor infraprojecten. Volg jij een technische hbo- of wo-opleiding en zoek je een meewerk- of afstudeerstage? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Dit wordt jouw stage

Voor betonconstructies komen steeds meer nieuwe materiaaloplossingen beschikbaar. Maar een materiaal met een lagere milieu-impact is niet automatisch voor iedere toepassing de beste keuze. Ook de sterkte, kosten en verwerking op de bouwplaats tellen mee. Hoe vergelijk je die oplossingen op een eerlijke manier? Dat ga jij onderzoeken.

Samen met je begeleider kies je een betonconstructie die als basis dient voor jouw onderzoek. Je onderzoekt hoe verschillende materiaaloplossingen aan dezelfde technische eisen kunnen voldoen. Vervolgens vergelijk je de oplossingen op technische prestaties, milieu-impact, kosten en praktische toepasbaarheid.

Afhankelijk van jouw opleiding, interesses en leerdoelen ga je aan de slag met:

  • Het kiezen van een geschikte betonconstructie en het vaststellen van de eisen waaraan deze moet voldoen.

  • Het verzamelen van informatie over bestaande en innovatieve materiaaloplossingen.

  • Het uitwerken van materiaalvarianten en het maken van constructieve berekeningen.

  • Het vergelijken van de varianten: wat zijn de voordelen, beperkingen en aandachtspunten?

  • Het vertalen van jouw resultaten naar een advies voor onze collega’s.

Je legt je aanpak, berekeningen en conclusies vast in een rapport en presenteert je bevindingen aan het team. Daarmee help je onze collega’s om beter onderbouwde materiaalkeuzes te maken.

Je staat er tijdens je onderzoek niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met constructeurs, ontwerpers en duurzaamheidsadviseurs en krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Zo leer je hoe constructief ontwerp en duurzaamheid in de praktijk samenkomen. Samen stemmen we de invulling en diepgang van de opdracht af op jouw opleiding en op de eisen van je meewerk- of afstudeerstage.

Bij ons breng je ook je eigen kennis en ideeën in. Je krijgt ruimte om vragen te stellen, initiatief te nemen en te ontdekken waar jouw interesses liggen. Zo maak je niet alleen meer van je studie, maar ook meer carrière.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Dit breng jij mee

  • Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Civiele Techniek, Constructieve Techniek, Structural Engineering, Built Environment met een constructieve specialisatie of een soort gelijke opleiding;

  • Je bent op zoek naar een stage voor minimaal vier dagen per week;

  • Je bent proactief en durft vragen te stellen;

  • Je bent analytisch, kritisch en onderzoekend;

  • Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van betonconstructies en constructieve berekeningen;

  • Je hebt interesse in innovatieve materialen en duurzaamheid.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een mooie stagevergoeding van € 700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week;

  • Bouw mee aan je toekomst: je stage is het perfecte startpunt om door te stromen naar een traineeship of startersbaan binnen Dura Vermeer;

  • Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en je eigen initiatieven te laten horen;

  • Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens;

  • Goede begeleiding van een ervaren collega of manager in jouw vakgebied. Je werkt tijdens je stage samen met fijne collega's die zorgen voor een leuke en professionele werksfeer;

  • Stage lopen én plezier maken: van kennismaking op de introductiedag tot leuke activiteiten en projectbezoeken met collega’s en medestagiaires.

Wil jij ook meer uit je stage halen?

Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Solliciteer direct via onze website met de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature (niet per e-mail).

Geef in jouw motivatiebrief duidelijk aan welke richting jou aanspreekt en wanneer je gewenste start- en einddatum is. Op die manier kunnen wij jou optimaal helpen.

Heb je vragen of wil je meer weten? Neem dan contact op met onze campus recruiter Daphne Hund. Je kunt haar een WhatsApp-bericht sturen via 06 1333 63 81.

Waar wacht je nog op? Grijp deze kans en solliciteer vandaag nog!

title: Stage E-commerce & Influencer Marketing (NL/BE), fulltime, start januari/februari 2027
descriptionHtml:
Wil je zien wat jouw ideeën doen voor een merk waar jonge ouders dol op zijn? Bij Petite Amélie zie je meteen het resultaat van je werk. Je zet bijvoorbeeld een samenwerking op met een Nederlandse influencer, of je bouwt een landingspagina voor een campagne, en je ziet direct wat het oplevert. Je haalt bij ons niet alleen koffie: vanaf dag één draai je volwaardig mee in ons marketing- & e-commerceteam, met de Nederlandse en Belgische markt als jouw terrein.

Over Petite Amélie

Wij ontwerpen en produceren meubels, accessoires en speelgoed voor baby- en kinderkamers, en jonge ouders in heel Europa zijn er dol op. We groeien snel, met webshops in Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Vanuit ons kantoor in Weesp (15 minuten met de trein vanaf Amsterdam Centraal) werken we met zo’n 30 collega’s aan het merk.

Wat ga je doen?

Ons team beheert de webshops en alle online kanalen. Organische groei en sterke content staan centraal. Je kiest samen met je begeleider waar je de nadruk op legt, op basis van je leerdoelen en interesses:

  • Influencers & samenwerkingen: je zoekt passende influencers en contentmakers in Nederland en België en neemt zelf contact met ze op. Je zet samenwerkingen op, zoals productgifting, contentdeals en campagnes, en je onderhoudt de relaties.

  • Content & social: je maakt content voor Instagram, TikTok en Pinterest en doet community management.

  • Campagnes & landingspagina’s: je helpt campagnes uitvoeren en bouwt en werkt aan pagina’s die converteren.

  • Webshop & merchandising: je bepaalt mee hoe producten in de shop worden gepresenteerd.

  • SEO & CRO: je zoekt uit waarom bezoekers wel of niet kopen, en wat we daaraan kunnen verbeteren.

  • Data & onderzoek: je rapporteert over e-commerce-KPI’s en doet marktonderzoek naar nieuwe kansen.

Aan het eind van je stage heb je echte resultaten en een eigen netwerk om te laten zien, en daarmee val je bij je volgende werkgever meteen op.

Wie zoeken we?

Dit heb je echt nodig:

  • Je studeert bedrijfskunde, marketing, communicatie, economie of iets vergelijkbaars, op hbo- of wo-niveau, en je stage is onderdeel van je opleiding (met stageovereenkomst).

  • Je bent fulltime beschikbaar voor minimaal 6 maanden, vanaf januari of februari 2027.

  • Je woont in Nederland.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed.

Dit maakt je een goede match:

  • Je pakt dingen zelf op, bent nieuwsgierig en denkt commercieel.

  • Je vindt het leuk om mensen te benaderen en relaties op te bouwen.

  • Je hebt oog voor design, interieur en esthetiek.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en graag samen.

Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt? Solliciteer toch. Enthousiasme en leergierigheid wegen voor ons zwaar.

Benefits

Dit bieden wij:

  • Een stagevergoeding van €650 per maand

  • Een OV-reisproduct of reiskostenvergoeding, en een laptop van de zaak

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van een vaste begeleider uit het team

  • Praktijkervaring in de hele e-commerce-mix: influencer marketing, social, community management, merchandising, webshopbeheer, analytics, SEO en CRO

  • Een warm, enthousiast team waarin je werk echt impact heeft, en waar we successen graag samen vieren

Klaar om ons te komen versterken?

Stuur je CV en vertel ons kort wie je bent. Je kunt een motivatie schrijven, maar je mag jezelf ook voorstellen met een reel, story of een ander creatief format. Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht.

Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. Daarna volgt een (video)kennismaking met je toekomstige begeleider, en je hoort snel of je in januari of februari kunt starten.

Wil jij tijdens je studie ervaren hoe het juridische werk er echt uitziet? En meteen iets betekenen voor mensen? Bij Univé Rechtshulp krijg je die kans.

Wie ben jij

Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding Rechten of SJD.

Je bent:

  • leergierig en nieuwsgierig

  • communicatief vaardig

  • betrokken en inlevend

  • niet bang om vragen te stellen en mee te denken

Wat ga je doen

Stel je eens voor:

  • Je helpt iemand die een conflict heeft met een werkgever

  • Of iemand heeft schade na een verkeersongeval en weet niet waar te beginnen

  • Of er speelt een juridisch probleem rondom wonen of een aankoop

Dan is het fijn dat jij meehelpt om duidelijkheid en oplossingen te bieden.

Tijdens je stage werk je mee aan verschillende juridische vraagstukken. Je ondersteunt rechtshulpverleners bij het behandelen van dossiers, zoals:

  • het opstellen van brieven en e-mails

  • het opvragen van informatie bij klanten en andere partijen

  • het uitzoeken van juridische vragen

Je werkt met echte dossiers en ziet wat jouw werk betekent voor onze leden.

Wat maakt deze stage waardevol voor jou

Bij Univé Rechtshulp krijg je de ruimte om te leren in de praktijk én jezelf te ontwikkelen.

  • Je doet ervaring op binnen verschillende rechtsgebieden

  • Je werkt samen met ervaren juristen en leert van hun aanpak

  • Je krijgt begeleiding van vaste stagebegeleiders

  • Je ontwikkelt je juridische én communicatieve vaardigheden

We nemen stages serieus. Je krijgt de kans om te ontdekken waar jouw interesses liggen en hoe het werkveld eruitziet.

Wat bieden wij

  • Een leerzame en afwisselende stage bij onze afdeling Juridisch Adviescentrum (JAC), Flex Letsel of Flex Verkeer.

  • Goede begeleiding door ervaren collega’s

  • Een werkomgeving waar je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen, inclusief interne opleidingen

  • Een stagevergoeding

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatie zonder winstoogmerk. We zijn er voor onze leden en helpen mensen bij juridische vragen die impact hebben op hun dagelijks leven. Dat doen we op een persoonlijke en praktische manier.

Bij Univé Rechtshulp werk je in een informele organisatie met betrokken collega’s. We werken samen, delen kennis en helpen elkaar verder. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en jouw rol te ontdekken.

Overige informatie

Enthousiast? Reageer via de sollicitatiebutton.

Wil je eerst meer weten over deze stage? Neem gerust contact met ons op.

Screening maakt onderdeel uit van de procedure.

title: System Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Bei uns arbeitest Du direkt an echten Kundenumgebungen.

Du migrierst Microsoft-365-Umgebungen, baust Azure-Netzwerke, analysierst komplexe Probleme und setzt Lösungen um, die beim Kunden sofort Wirkung zeigen.

Wir suchen keine Leute, die einfach Tasks abarbeiten. Wir suchen Engineers, die ihr Handwerk verstehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und technische Probleme sauber lösen wollen.

Die Zertifikate Microsoft AZ-104 und AZ-700 sind die Grundvoraussetzung für das Erfüllen der Anforderungen. Falls Zertifizierungen fehlen, unterstützen wir Dich aktiv dabei diese zu erlangen.

Die Stelle erfordert zudem Mobilität und klare Kommunikation. Ein Führerausweis der Kategorie B sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Als System Engineer arbeitest Du an realen Kundenumgebungen – nicht im Labor.

Du migrierst Server, planst Microsoft 365- und Azure-Umstellungen, richtest Netzwerke ein und sorgst dafür, dass Systeme laufen. Du arbeitest direkt mit Entscheidungsträgern zusammen, triffst technische Entscheidungen selbst und trägst Verantwortung für stabile Resultate.

Wenn Du Praxiserfahrung in Projekten und die nötige technische Tiefe mitbringst, erwartet Dich eine Umgebung, in der Eigeninitiative und Verbindlichkeit mehr zählen als Hierarchie.

Am Morgen analysierst Du ein VPN-Problem. Am Nachmittag planst Du eine Microsoft-365-Migration. Dazwischen sprichst Du direkt mit einem Kunden-Geschäftsführer über die zukünftige Infrastruktur.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Planung und Umsetzung von Microsoft 365- und Azure-Migrationen (Exchange, Fileserver, Infrastruktur)
  • Durchführung von Server- und Datenmigrationen von On-Premise zu Cloud oder Hybrid-Umgebungen
  • Einrichtung und Betreuung von Azure-Netzwerken, VPNs, Firewalls, Routing und Security-Policies
  • Analyse und Behebung technischer Probleme im 2nd / 3rd Level-Support
  • Vorbereitung und Dokumentation von Kundenumgebungen, inkl. Betriebsdokumentation
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, Netzwerk- und Operations-Team bei Projekten
  • Mitarbeit an Konzepten für Rollouts, Standardisierung und Automatisierung
  • Mitarbeit in internen Projekten zur Standardisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Kommunikations- und Cloudlösungen.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Informatik (EFZ oder vergleichbar) oder ausweisbare Qualifikation
  • Praxis in Migrationen von Servern, Microsoft 365 und Azure-Umgebungen
  • Gute Kenntnisse in: Microsoft 365, Azure AD, Exchange Online, Intune, SharePoint Online, Windows Server, Active Directory, Fileserver / GPOs, Netzwerken (Routing, VPN, VLAN, Firewalls), Veeam Backup oder vergleichbaren Backup-Lösungen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

Zertifizierungen

Folgende Zertifizierungen sind vorhanden oder deren Erreichung wird gemeinsam vereinbart. Die Zertifizierungskosten werden durch uns übernommen.

  • Zertifizierungen AZ-104 (Azure Administrator)
  • AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer)

Benefits

Spannende Projekte

Du arbeitest direkt an Lösungen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und setzt Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung eigenständig oder im Team um.

Eigenverantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum

Du übernimmst Verantwortung statt Routinerollen. Du planst, entscheidest, baust um und führst Projekte selbstständig – unterstützt von einem Team mit klarer Leistungskultur und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Starke Rahmenbedingungen

40-Stunden-Woche, 30 Tage Ferien, pauschale Mobile-Spesen und moderne Arbeitsmittel gehören bei uns dazu.

Firmenfahrzeug

Für Kundentermine und Projekteinsätze stehen Dir Firmenfahrzeuge zur geschäftlichen Nutzung zur Verfügung. Du arbeitest dort, wo Resultate entstehen – im direkten Austausch mit den Kunden.

Weiterentwicklung garantiert

Wir investieren gezielt in Dich. Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien wie Azure, Intune, 3CX, Fortinet oder Sophos und wirst aktiv in deiner Entwicklung unterstützt – inkl. Zeitbudget für Zertifizierungen und Trainings.

Professionelles Arbeitsumfeld

Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, klare Abläufe und nachvollziehbare Verantwortung. Home-Office ist möglich, wird aber als Mittel zum Ergebnis verstanden – Verantwortung hat Priorität.

Bei der MDigital AG erwartet Dich ein Engineering-Team, das fachlich stark, kollegial und auf Augenhöhe unterwegs ist. Du arbeitest in einem professionellen Umfeld mit viel Eigenverantwortung und realem Gestaltungsspielraum.

title: Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist
descriptionHtml:

The Role

Our Talent Acquisition team is growing! We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist to join our team in London.

In this role you will own sourcing strategy for our hardest, business-critical roles, turning hiring briefs into talent maps, targeted headhunting and market intelligence, and build the talent pipelines that give every search a warm start and drive our internal model. Key Responsibilities

  • Own sourcing strategy for business-critical, specialist and hard-to-fill roles, agreeing a brief with the TA Manager and hiring manager that covers essential skills, evidence of capability, target markets and candidate motivations, within priorities set by the Head of TA

  • Lead proactive headhunting to identify, engage and build relationships with high-calibre passive candidates, writing tailored outreach and testing messages and channels

  • Lead talent mapping and market research on competitors, emerging talent pools and market trends, looking beyond familiar job titles and companies

  • Use LinkedIn Recruiter, AI, automation and talent intelligence tools to improve sourcing, measure what lifts reply and conversion rates, and share best practice across the TA team

  • Track sourcing metrics, pipeline quality and conversion rates, including time to first qualified shortlist, handover acceptance and progression to interview, to measure impact and find improvements

  • Learn Quantum’s business and employer proposition, and keep high standards of candidate experience, data integrity, contact preferences and recruitment compliance

About You

  • Experience in talent sourcing, headhunting or talent research, from agency or in-house, with examples of finding and engaging passive candidates beyond inbound applications

  • A track record of sourcing specialist, technical or hard-to-fill roles through proactive headhunting and talent mapping, with reply rates you can quote

  • Strong search skills, including Boolean techniques, LinkedIn Recruiter and talent intelligence or AI tools, and willingness to test and improve your methods

  • Analytical skills: able to turn market research and talent data into clear insight, and to measure sourcing through pipeline quality, shortlist delivery and conversion

  • Clear, persuasive writing and the ability to build trust with passive candidates in an initial conversation

  • Stakeholder skills to build credibility with TA Managers, leadership and hiring managers, with commercial awareness of talent markets, competitor activity and candidate expectations

  • Curiosity about different careers, and the judgement to assess transferable skills against a specific brief

  • Strong organisation and prioritisation to manage four to five live searches, with care for confidential information and an inclusive approach to search

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Operations & Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
En bref

Chez Picnic, notre croissance opérationnelle en France s’accélère : plusieurs nouvelles zones logistiques sont prévues dès fin 2026 et début 2027. En tant que Recruteur / Recruteuse Supply Chain & Opérations, tu joueras un rôle clé dans cette expansion en recrutant les leaders qui construiront et feront grandir nos nouveaux sites logistiques.

Ton périmètre couvre des postes clés pour nos opérations : superviseurs, chefs d’équipe, ingénieurs projets et responsables de sites. Tu travailleras au plus près de nos équipes opérationnelles et de nos Hiring Managers, en comprenant leurs enjeux, en construisant les stratégies de recrutement adaptées et en identifiant les profils capables de faire grandir Picnic.

Chez Picnic, le recrutement ne consiste pas simplement à remplir des postes. Nous voulons construire des équipes solides et durables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur les talents que nous recrutons. Tu auras donc une vraie autonomie sur tes recrutements : tu définiras tes priorités, piloteras tes pipelines et challengeras les approches lorsque cela sera nécessaire pour atteindre tes objectifs sans faire de compromis sur la qualité.

Tu seras également un véritable partenaire du business : tes Hiring Managers sont directement impliqués dans le recrutement et considèrent la construction de leur équipe comme une priorité. Ton rôle sera de leur apporter ton expertise recrutement, de faciliter les prises de décision et de les conseiller tout au long du processus.

Tes missions

  • Piloter tes recrutements de A à Z : tu prends en charge tes recrutements, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la signature, et construis les pipelines nécessaires pour atteindre tes objectifs.

  • Accompagner notre expansion en France : tu recrutes les profils clés qui permettront l’ouverture et le développement de nos nouveaux sites logistiques.

  • Définir ta stratégie de recrutement : tu identifies les bons profils, marchés et canaux de sourcing, et adaptes ton approche en fonction de tes résultats.

  • Être un partenaire du business : tu travailles main dans la main avec tes Hiring Managers, les conseilles sur leurs recrutements et les challenges lorsque nécessaire.

  • Maintenir un haut niveau d’exigence : tu évalues les candidats avec rigueur et veilles à construire des équipes solides et durables.

À propos de toi

  • Tu as 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en recrutement, idéalement dans un environnement à forte croissance ou en évolution rapide.
  • Tu sais prendre des décisions en autonomie et construire une stratégie de recrutement pour atteindre tes objectifs.
  • Tu es à l’aise pour conseiller et challenger tes Hiring Managers, tout en construisant une relation de confiance avec eux.
  • Tu accordes beaucoup d’importance à la qualité des recrutements et sais maintenir un niveau d’exigence élevé.
  • Tu es structuré.e, organisé.e et capable de gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités en parallèle.
  • Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Tu es diplômé.e d’un Master en commerce, ressources humaines, psychologie ou dans un domaine similaire.
  • Chez Picnic, nous utilisons Greenhouse comme ATS. C’est un plus si tu le connais déjà, mais pas indispensable.

Avantages Picnic

🍴 Restauration 

Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux restaurants du coin. Notre petite cuisine est également équipée de savoureux en-cas et rafraîchissements.

🚲 Santé et transports

Grâce à nos partenariats avec Sidecare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, si tu te rends au travail en transports en commun, nous te remboursons ton abonnement à hauteur de 50%.

✍️ Développement personnel et professionnel

Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à un environnement dynamique, jeune et international.

🎫Sorties et divertissement

Profite d'un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu profiteras aussi d'inviations à tous nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party !

title: Teamleider Inbound
descriptionHtml:

Als Teamleider Inbound zorg jij dat de voorraad altijd klopt en dat jouw team elke dag met plezier de targets haalt.


Wat ga je doen?

In deze rol ben je het aanspreekpunt op de vloer voor de goederenontvangst. Je rapporteert aan onze Warehouse Manager en werkt nauw samen met je collega-Teamleiders van Outbound en Retouren om de dagelijkse operatie soepel te laten verlopen.

• Aansturing op de vloer: Je coacht, motiveert en begeleidt jouw team van 4 tot 8 medewerkers. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig en werkt waar nodig mee.

• WMS-beheer (Picqer): Je zorgt voor een foutloze inslag. Je ziet toe op een strikte scan-discipline en lost administratieve verschillen in het systeem direct op.

• Planning & Forecast: Je maakt de personeelsplanning (via Dyflexis), waarbij je 4 tot 6 weken vooruitkijkt om drukke periodes op te vangen.

• Procesbewaking: Je schakelt snel met de afdeling Inkoop en zorgt dat de fysieke binnenkomst van orders naadloos aansluit op de administratieve afhandeling.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een praktische leider die van aanpakken weet, rust brengt in de hectiek en het overzicht bewaart tussen de stellingen.

• Ervaring: Je hebt ervaring in een logistieke omgeving en bent toe aan een tweede stap in je carrière of je hebt al ervaring als (assistent) teamleider.

• Niveau: Je beschikt over MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau.

• Hand-on mentaliteit: Je bent analytisch genoeg om een planning te maken, maar je vindt het heerlijk om het grootste deel van je dag fysiek in het magazijn aanwezig te zijn.

• Communicatie: Je bent een teamplayer die makkelijk communiceert met zowel je eigen team als je collega-teamleads.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een uitdagende leidinggevende rol in een groeiende, sportieve organisatie.

• Een marktconform salaris dat aansluit bij jouw ervaring. De functie is ingeschaald in Schaalgroep D van de CAO Retail Non-Food, met een salarisrange van € 2.638 tot € 3.196 bruto per maand (vanaf 21 jaar, op basis van een 38-urige werkweek).

• Werken in een gepassioneerd team in een splinternieuw/dynamisch magazijn.

• Gebruik van de eigen All4running gym, korting op ons assortiment en gratis startbewijzen voor hardloopevenementen.

• Reiskostenvergoeding (vanaf 12,5 km) en een thuiswerkvergoeding (voor de momenten dat je de planning maakt).

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
descriptionHtml:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised..

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Warehouse Operative
descriptionHtml:
About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Warehouse Operative at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Warehouse Operative at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to keep our pharmacy floor moving-so patients get the treatment they're counting on.

You'll own your area of the dispensary, keeping packing stations stocked and dispensers supported. You'll anticipate what's needed, respond quickly and tackle bottlenecks before they interrupt the flow. Every minute matters.

You'll bring precision to the pace. From matching medication strengths to orders and protecting the cold chain to spotting stock discrepancies, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll keep your area clear, organised and ready for the next order.

Working alongside Dispensers, fellow Warehouse Operatives and shift leadership, you'll help Bolt Pharmacy deliver more as we grow. You'll take initiative, flag problems early and step in where the team needs you. Your impact is hands-on, immediate and felt in every order that leaves the building.

Great performance means packers get a response within 3 minutes, packing runs without avoidable interruptions and medicines stay protected. Your area consistently meets our safety and housekeeping standards, and colleagues can count on you every shift.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working shifts to support warehouse operations.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's dispensing and operations team.

Key responsibilities

  • Keep packing flowing: Patrol your area, respond to packer requests within 3 minutes and replenish medicines and consumables before supplies run out.

  • Get medication control right: Supply only one medication strength and one matching stack of orders per packing table at a time, verifying the match before replenishing.

  • Protect the cold chain: Follow cold-chain procedures and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements, returning temperature-controlled medicines to the fridge immediately when no longer needed.

  • Handle medicines safely: Use designated holding areas, never leave medicines unattended in walkways or packing areas, and immediately quarantine damaged or suspect stock for Shift Lead review.

  • Keep the floor safe and ready: Clear cardboard, keep stations tidy and exits unobstructed, remove immediate hazards and report concerns promptly. Operate equipment only within your training and authorisation.

  • Work as one team: Support fellow Warehouse Operatives, cover neighbouring areas during breaks and promptly flag stock discrepancies or rotation errors.

Need to have

  • Warehouse knowledge: You understand warehouse operations, stock control, Health & Safety and GDP requirements, and put them into practice.

  • Attention to detail: You check medication strengths, order matches and storage conditions carefully. Accuracy is essential.

  • Ownership: You stay organised, anticipate what's needed and manage your area independently as priorities change.

  • Teamwork: You communicate clearly, flag issues early and bring reliable, consistent effort to every shift.

  • A hands-on approach: You can fulfil the role's physical duties, including continuous on-foot activity and routine manual handling.

Nice to have

  • Regulated operations: You've worked in regulated warehousing, logistics, pharmacy or healthcare.

  • Cold-chain knowledge: You understand how to handle temperature-controlled medicines and protect them throughout the packing process.

  • Warehouse systems: You've used warehouse management tools to track stock and identify discrepancies.

  • Equipment qualifications: You hold forklift or pump truck certification, or baler sign-off. If you don't, we'll provide training.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

  • Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

  • GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

  • Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

title: Werkstudent IT-Systemadministration (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder etwas Vergleichbares und willst neben dem Studium an echter Infrastruktur arbeiten statt nur an Übungsaufgaben? Du hast vielleicht schon ein Homelab, den Familien-PC-Support an der Backe oder einfach Spaß daran, herauszufinden, warum etwas nicht läuft? Dann passt du zu uns.

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Technik verstehen willst, zuverlässig bist und Fragen stellst. Den Rest lernst du bei uns, mit Kollegen, die mit dir draufschauen, und einem eigenen Lab zum Ausprobieren.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten, das IT-Infrastruktur für Unternehmen in der Region baut und betreibt.

Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Team beim Aufbau und Betrieb von Server- und Netzwerkumgebungen bei unseren Kunden

  • Du baust Server und Workstations zusammen, installierst sie und prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren

  • Du hilfst bei der zentralen Betreuung unserer Kundenumgebungen, zum Beispiel bei Patching, Monitoring und Backup-Kontrollen

  • Du richtest Benutzer, Postfächer und Lizenzen in Microsoft 365 ein

  • Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen unserer Kunden und holst dir Hilfe, wenn es knifflig wird

  • Du dokumentierst Lösungen so, dass auch der nächste durchblickt

  • Du automatisierst, was sich wiederholt, und bringst eigene Ideen ein

  • Du begleitest deine Kollegen zu Einsätzen beim Kunden vor Ort

Du arbeitest von Anfang an an echten Kundenprojekten mit und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr eigene Aufgaben. Und du sitzt mit deinen Problemen nicht allein da: Es ist immer jemand da, der mit dir draufschaut.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Student, idealerweise in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Studiengang

  • Du hast bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit, in den Semesterferien gern mehr

  • Du interessierst dich für Server, Netzwerke und Betriebssysteme und hast Grundkenntnisse in Windows

  • Du arbeitest dich selbst in Neues ein und bleibst dran, wenn ein Problem nicht beim ersten Versuch gelöst ist

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig und sagst Bescheid, wenn etwas nicht klappt oder du einen Fehler gemacht hast

  • Du sprichst gutes Deutsch und kannst Technik verständlich erklären

Schön, wenn du das schon kannst (sonst lernst du es bei uns):

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Windows Server, Virtualisierung oder Microsoft 365, zum Beispiel aus einem Homelab, einer Ausbildung oder einem Nebenjob

  • Grundverständnis für Netzwerke: Du weißt, was Firewall, VPN und Routing tun

  • Erste Schritte mit Linux oder Skripting in PowerShell oder Bash

  • Führerschein Klasse B

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als gute Noten. Wichtig ist, dass du sauber arbeitest und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Eigenes Lab und lokale KI-Power. Du hast ein eigenes Lab zum Testen und Ausprobieren und arbeitest mit lokaler KI-Hardware.

Praxis, die im Studium fehlt. Du arbeitest an echten Kundenumgebungen und lernst, wie IT-Infrastruktur im Alltag wirklich betrieben wird.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. Aktueller Stack, KI-gestütztes Arbeiten (unter anderem mit Claude) und kein Altlast-Ballast, der dich ausbremst.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten. Vorlesungen und Klausurphasen gehen vor. Deine Arbeitszeiten stimmen wir mit deinem Stundenplan ab.

Start-up-Flair. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Eigenverantwortung und eine Atmosphäre, in der Ideen mehr zählen als Hierarchien.

Home-Office. Nach der Einarbeitung ist Home-Office in Absprache möglich.

Perspektive nach dem Studium. Wenn es passt, sprechen wir gern über Abschlussarbeit und Festanstellung.

Das sehen wir als Standard an

  • Ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz mit leistungsstarker Workstation

  • Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee im Büro

  • Ein sauber aufgeräumter und voll ausgestatteter Firmenbulli für Kundeneinsätze

Wenn du neben dem Studium nicht nur Geld verdienen, sondern wirklich etwas lernen willst, dann bewirb dich bei uns!

title: Werkstudent Operational Planning (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei FlixTrain gesaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.

Zweck und Verantwortlichkeiten:
Unser Operational Planning Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere Züge pünktlich und effizient durch Deutschland fahren. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt du das Team bei der Umsetzung und Pflege unserer Fahrplandaten – eine zentrale Grundlage für unseren Betrieb.

Auswirkungen auf die Organisation:
Deine Arbeit sorgt für reibungslose Abläufe im täglichen Zugbetrieb, beeinflusst die Reiseerfahrung unserer Fahrgäste und ermöglicht datenbasierte Entscheidungen im Unternehmen.

Tools, Plattformen oder Prozesse:
Wir arbeiten mit unterschiedlichen Planungstools und Datenschnittstellen, wobei insbesondere Excel und interne Systeme zur Erstellung und Pflege der Fahrplandaten eingesetzt werden.

Über die Rolle

  • Unterstützung des Teams für Betriebs- und Fahrplanung im Schienenpersonenverkehr
  • Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Fahrplandateien für interne Abteilungen und externe Partner
  • Umsetzung von Fahrplanänderungen, etwa bei Bauarbeiten oder Störungen
  • Pflege und Abgleich von betriebsrelevanten Daten über verschiedene Schnittstellen
  • Mitarbeit bei der Kundenkommunikation im Falle von Fahrplanänderungen (z. B. Umbuchungen)
  • Kontrolle und Aktualisierung von Haltestellen-, Strecken- und Zeitdaten
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem rund 10-köpfigen Team am Standort Berlin

Über Dich

  • Eingeschriebener Bachelor- oder Masterstudierende in einem relevanten Studiengang: Verkehrsingenieurwesen, Verkehrslogistik, Mobilitätsmanagement, Tourismusmanagement, BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Geographie, Stadt- und Regionalplanung oder Informatik
  • 6 Monate Verfügbarkeit für ca. 20 Stunden die Woche
  • Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Mobilitäts- oder Verkehrsbranche wünschenswert
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel, Word und Outlook
  • Sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Auge für Details
  • Selbstständigkeit, Teamfähigkeit und Spaß an datengetriebener Arbeit
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Interesse an Verkehrsplanung, Zugbetrieb und Datenmanagement im Mobilitätssektor

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100% erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Was Wir Bieten

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden?

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und preiswert zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten.

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

title: Working Student AI Engineer – LLMs, RAG & AI Agents
descriptionHtml:
IMPORTANT Application note

Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you.

About AgentixLake

AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.

Your role

Build AI application components that are ready to be tested, deployed and maintained. You will take ownership of defined engineering work within our generative AI projects, collaborating with colleagues on implementation, review and operational quality.

Our team builds enterprise AI solutions that connect models with useful data and tools. Your work may contribute to document intelligence, knowledge assistants, governed analytics or AI agents that support engineering and operational workflows.

What you will do

Develop Python services and integrations connecting language models to enterprise data, APIs and tools.

Implement document ingestion, chunking, embeddings and retrieval, with source references that users can inspect.

Build structured extraction and validation workflows for complex documents and downstream business systems.

Implement defined agent steps, including tool calls, permission checks, error handling and human approval.

Maintain evaluation cases and compare retrieval quality, answer usefulness, latency and cost as the application changes.

Contribute automated tests, deployment configuration, logging and documentation through reviewed pull requests.

What you bring

Current university enrolment in computer science, AI, data science or a related technical discipline.

Strong practical Python skills and evidence of software you have delivered for actual users, including responsibility for testing and deployment.

Hands-on experience with an LLM application involving retrieval, tool use or structured outputs, and the ability to explain its limitations.

Comfort working with APIs, JSON, Git and code review, and taking a defined task from an agreed requirement to a maintainable implementation.

Clear English communication and an evidence-based approach to debugging and evaluating system behaviour.

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, FastAPI, Docker, vector databases or self-hosted models is valuable. We value sound implementation decisions more than the number of frameworks on your CV.

What you can expect

You will contribute to real delivery work with direct access to experienced engineers and the founders. Expect clear ownership, thoughtful code review and a part-time scope planned around your studies.

How to apply

Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Explain one AI application you built, your individual contribution, how you evaluated it and what you improved after testing. An anonymised description is welcome; please do not share confidential client material.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you.

Stay connected

Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions.

title: Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites.

Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field.

We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine.

Your role

You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to.

What you will do

  • Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials

  • Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field

  • Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials

  • Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests

  • Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly

  • Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production

How we work

  • Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document.

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before.

  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design.

  • Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you.

  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to the founders, the software and RF team, and the sites where our systems run, so that all the pieces fit together in the field.

Requirements

  • You study mechanical engineering, product design, mechatronics, or a similar field

  • You have strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor)

  • You have built real hardware, not only modelled it

  • You have operated a CNC mill, or you are ready to learn it on ours

  • You understand design for manufacturing

  • You go from idea to prototype on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck

  • You are available up to 20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks if you want

Helpful, not required

  • Basic CAM knowledge (e.g. Fusion 360 CAM)

  • Experience with FDM or resin 3D printing, turning, sheet metal, or composites

  • Electronics basics: wiring, sensors, integrating PCBs and antennas into enclosures

  • Projects you built yourself: maker work, Formula Student, university teams, a portfolio

  • Rendering and visual design

  • Experience with rugged or outdoor hardware

  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Benefits

  • Work on a real product that ends up in real deployments

  • Your own workshop with a CNC mill and 3D printers: design a part in the morning, hold it in your hand by the afternoon

  • Flexible hours around lectures and exams

  • Compensation: €16–20 per hour

  • 6-month contract with the option to extend

  • Perspective for a thesis or a long-term role as we grow

  • Insight into real RF hardware and field deployments

  • Workshop and main workplace in Horneburg (R&D). Days without hands-on work can be done from our Hamburg HafenCity HQ

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (15 min, remote): who you are, why Datacept

  2. Project conversation (45 min): bring what you built (CAD, photos, parts), and we start with a small design challenge right away

  3. Final meeting in person at our workshop in Horneburg with the founders

  4. Reference check and offer within 48 hours

About Datacept

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure. Our platform unifies passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, and the RF data infrastructure that ties them together.

We have raised pre-seed capital and are backed by German federal funding. We work with critical infrastructure operators, defence agencies, and NATO partners to give Europe the intelligence we need in the electromagnetic spectrum.
